title: 2-Year Analyst, Real Estate Reporting & Technology
description:
Fund Description

Carlyle's U.S. real estate business invests primarily in demographic-based sectors, targeting assets that we believe offer compelling value propositions to deep and growing demand pools. The continuity of our senior leadership, the depth and experience of our investment professionals, and our presence in key target markets underlie the success of our business.

Since 1998, Carlyle U.S. Real Estate has successfully navigated diverse economic and real estate market conditions. With a focus on demographic-based themes, we target real estate assets that we believe offer compelling value propositions to deep and growing demand pools. Our team assesses sectors using a proprietary framework of criteria that evaluates predictability and resilience of demand.

Led by Rob Stuckey as Head of U.S. Real Estate since 1998, our deep and talented team of over 150 real estate professionals bolsters the business through dedicated sourcing, transaction, and asset management responsibilities.

Position Summary

The 2-Year Analyst will support financial analysis, reporting, process improvement, and technology initiatives across Carlyle's U.S. Real Estate business. The Analyst will use strong Excel and analytical skills, along with modern AI and automation tools, to improve recurring processes, enhance reporting, and develop solutions for business users.

The Analyst will work with members of the U.S. Real Estate team and software developers to translate business needs into practical technology solutions, test new functionality, and support implementation. This is a unique opportunity for an early-career professional interested in the intersection of finance, real estate, data analytics, and technology.

The Analyst will support reporting and analysis across the U.S. Real Estate portfolio, including asset-level operating performance, valuations, debt, acquisitions, dispositions, and fund-level performance. This work will draw on data from internal systems, financial models, property managers, and third-party providers.

In-Office Requirement: 4 days per week

Primary Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting

  • Support recurring reporting across the U.S. Real Estate portfolio, including valuations, asset-level operating performance, debt, dispositions, acquisition activity, and fund-level performance
  • Build, maintain, and analyze Excel-based financial and data models
  • Analyze quarter-over-quarter changes in investment performance and valuations to identify the drivers behind those changes
  • Aggregate, validate, and reconcile information received from investment teams, financial models, and reporting systems
  • Prepare analyses, presentations, and reporting materials for senior management
  • Assist with ad hoc financial, operational, and investment-related analyses

Process Improvement and Automation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring financial, reporting, and operational processes
  • Use modern AI and automation tools to improve data analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency
  • Develop and maintain tools that improve data quality, reduce manual work, and provide business users with better access to information
  • Document processes and apply appropriate review and quality-control procedures to AI-generated analyses, automated workflows, and reporting outputs
  • Help measure the impact of process improvements and automation initiatives

Business and Technology Development Support

  • Work with business users and software developers to translate business needs into clear and actionable requirements
  • Support testing and implementation of new functionality and confirm that delivered solutions meet business requirements
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to support rapid prototyping, analysis, and application development
  • Communicate technical concepts and system functionality clearly to business users

Data Analytics and Special Projects

  • Develop dashboards, visualizations, and analyses that provide insights into investment and portfolio performance
  • Assist with data extraction, transformation, and modeling from multiple systems and sources
  • Support other strategic, reporting, and technology initiatives as requested by senior management
  • Support the evaluation and integration of third-party data sources and reporting tools

Requirements

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, real estate, economics, business, data analytics, computer science, or a related field
  • Strong academic record; GPA of at least 3.5 preferred
  • 1-2 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, consulting, reporting, data analytics, real estate, or technology-enabled process improvement
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including financial analysis, data modeling, and working with large or complex datasets
  • Hands-on experience using modern AI tools to support analysis, automation, or software development.
  • Ability to work with software developers to translate business needs into technical requirements and test delivered solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly motivated, intellectually curious, and able to learn and apply new technologies quickly

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to finance, accounting, real estate, or investment performance concepts, including IRR, equity multiples, cash flow analysis, or property-level operating metrics
  • Experience with financial reporting, performance analytics, dashboard development, or data visualization tools
  • Familiarity with commercial real estate valuation software or third-party valuation data
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and AI tools integrated with Excel
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, version control, or similar data and development tools
  • Exposure to agentic AI workflows, APIs, system integrations, or internal application development

Benefits/Compensation

The compensation range for this role is specific to Washington, DC and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $100,000.

In addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. Additionally, the hired professional may also be eligible to participate in an annual discretionary incentive program, the award of which will be dependent on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Due to the high volume of candidates, please be advised that only candidates selected to interview will be contacted by Carlyle

Who We Are


When people, ideas, and capital come together, opportunity expands across private markets. At Carlyle, this belief has shaped how we invest for decades, fueling growth for companies and delivering performance for investors.

description:
Title: Archaeologist
Location: Guam

Position Information

SEARCH has an immediate opening for Full-Time Archaeologists to join our Terrestrial Archaeology division for multiple opportunities in Guam. Selected candidates must be Secretary of the Interior Qualified in Archaeology and based in Guam at time of hire. In addition to local projects, archaeologists will participate in SEARCH projects outside of the island.

SEARCH provides a flexible work environment, a professional and collaborative atmosphere, and a wide range of projects and opportunities for our staff. SEARCH offers a competitive total compensation package with strong health and wellness and retirement plans. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, group term life insurance, 401(k) plan with match, 11 paid holidays per year, and accrued paid time off (PTO). Pay is commensurate with education and experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to project health and safety plans and participate in office and field trainings and meetings.
  • Conduct archaeological monitoring, survey, testing, and excavation in support of Phase I, II, and III studies in accordance with the research design to identify, record, and evaluate historic and prehistoric cultural resources.
  • Recognize archaeological signatures and apply reasoning to evaluate resources.
  • Evaluate and record accurate, organized, and clear field notes, maps, drawings, logs, forms, tables, databases, artifact bags, box labels, and other project documentation.
  • Collect and inventory artifacts, ecofacts, and samples in accordance with the research design, and keep an accurate field specimen log.
  • Identify potential human and faunal remains, and treat any suspected human burial remains respectfully and in a manner consistent with the research design and applicable State and Federal guidelines and laws.
  • Perform quality control of field data (hand-written and electronic) on a daily basis to ensure information is accurate and complete.
  • Use electronic and traditional navigational equipment (GPS, iPad/ArcCollector/Survey 123, compass, transit, etc.) to determine project limits, record fieldwork, document findings, and communicate progress.
  • Photo-document artifacts, features, excavation units, land use, landscapes, unique environmental features, historic structures, archaeology sites, unique environmental features, specialized equipment or technique usage, and work-in-progress.
  • Procure and maintain field equipment, technology, field laboratory supplies, vehicles, and supplies in a clean, working, and safe manner.
  • Occasionally meet with, coordinate, and collaborate with landowners, land agents, clients, other field research teams, and visiting regulatory agency staff.
  • Travel for extended periods of time.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications Required:

  • Graduate degree in Anthropology, Archaeology, or a related field.
  • Meet the Secretary of the Interior (SOI) qualifications for archaeology.
  • Live in Guam at time of hire.
  • Experience with pacific island archaeology.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks in variable terrain and environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A valid driver’s license and access to reliable transportation.
  • Demonstrative knowledge of and familiarity with performing archaeological monitoring, survey and excavation.


Application Requirements

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • Cover Letter
  • References


Other Important Need-to-Know Information

  • This position will require flexible availability outside of standard working hours.

title: Developer (ITS)
location: Los Angeles, CA - University Park Campus
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The University of Southern California’s (USC’s) Information Technology Services is seeking a talented Developer for Cloud Applications. The Developer will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting software applications and solutions within USC’s Workday environment, including application development, Workday Extend, and integrations.

The Developer will be an integral member of the Cloud Applications team, collaborating with diverse and talented team members to help solve multidimensional information technology problems, improve customer experience, and generate value for our campus stakeholders across a broad base of departments and constituencies.

THE TEAM

The Cloud Applications team is part of ITS Application Services within Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA). The team supports Workday and related applications across USC, including functions such as human resources, payroll, benefits, recruiting, and financials.

The team works with stakeholders across the University, including USC schools and business units, staff and employees, HR, payroll, benefits, hospitals and health-system entities, system owners, and external vendors that interact with USC through Workday.

This is an opportunity to join a core technology function supporting business-critical systems and processes across USC. The role will contribute to maintaining existing Workday applications and integrations while supporting application development, operational-efficiency improvements, and future initiatives.

We are looking for top talent to join us on our journey.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Developer:

  • Creates, develops, revises, and maintains software applications and solutions, adapting to regularly changing priorities. Ensures code is maintained, supported, and performs as intended upon implementation. Produces and presents problem-solving rationale within a variety of settings to diverse audiences. Collaborates with key stakeholders within ITS and other university departments, working to develop understanding of technical specifications and deliver features and services based on business requirements.

  • Supports project and task planning, contributing to the development and execution of processes and procedures and ensuring alignment with university and ITS objectives and customer needs. Assists with security governance, policies, and overall university compliance by embedding standards, procedures, and quality analysis measures into workflows/plans. Identifies and communicates system issues, bugs, and fixes, and aids the initiation of process-improvement efforts within teams and across ITS.

  • Handles and routes customer requests appropriately for tracking and resolution. Supports customer point-of-views when identifying priorities and presenting solutions, leveraging insights on customer pain points, challenges, and needs. Provides customer-focused solutions and builds and maintains effective customer relationships through timely follow-ups and efficient, effective feedback.

  • Leverages the latest industry knowledge and best practices to facilitate innovation, continuous improvement, and effective troubleshooting and problem-solving. Proactively experiments with and analyzes new approaches and complex, diverse, and/or conflicting datasets to identify root causes. Develops and maintains knowledge base articles, tutorials, and training resources.

  • Aids the cultivation of an inclusive environment and a culture of trust and transparency, sharing information broadly, openly, and deliberately. Builds and maintains collaborative relationships with diverse team members, peers, and leaders. Actively embodies ITS values and behaviors (e.g., accountability, ethics, best-in-class customer service).

  • Collaborates with team members and management, implementing effective solutions to support the Application Services team’s vision. Maintains currency with technology, standards, and best practices. Supports process improvement efforts within the team and across the ITS organization.

In addition, the successful candidate must also demonstrate, through ideas, words and actions, a strong commitment to USC’s Unifying Values of integrity, excellence, community, well-being, open communication, and accountability.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

The candidate for the position of Developer must meet the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as computer science, computer information systems, etc., or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

  • Two years’ experience in information technology, software development, engineering, or relevant fields.

  • Foundational knowledge of security concepts, secure code development techniques, and the development and configuration of software solutions.

  • Ability to understand and work with large, complex systems, write test cases for new and existing code to ensure compatibility and stability, and provide detailed information and summaries to peers and supervisors.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to establish strong, positive working relationships and rapport with diverse groups of team members.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate for the position of Developer has the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science.

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in information technology.

  • Experience in higher education.

  • Experience with Workday applications, integrations, or related technologies.

  • Experience with Workday Extend and/or application development within the Workday environment.

  • Strong technical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and support complex applications and systems.

  • Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, learn new technologies and approaches, and work collaboratively in a high-volume environment.

ITS CULTURE

USC’s ITS organization represents a diverse and talented team, committed to supporting a collaborative culture and delivering secure and innovative IT services, core to the mission of USC. ITS values accountability, excellence, and commitment to exceptional customer experience. ITS strives for a supportive and inclusive culture that encourages employees to do their best work every day and where individuals are recognized and celebrated for their contributions.

The Cloud Applications team values strong technical capability as well as strong interpersonal and customer-facing skills. The hiring manager emphasized the importance of a positive attitude, adaptability, collaboration, communication, and alignment with USC’s culture, values, ethics, compliance, and safe technology practices.

ABOUT USC

USC is the leading private research university in Los Angeles—a global center for arts, technology, and international business. With more than 47,500 students, we are located primarily in Los Angeles but also in various US and global satellite locations. As the largest private employer in Los Angeles, responsible for $8 billion annually in economic activity in the region, we offer the opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse environment, in careers that span a broad spectrum of talents and skills across a variety of academic and professional schools and administrative units. As a USC employee and member of the Trojan Family—the faculty, staff, students, and alumni who make USC a great place to work—you will enjoy excellent benefits, including a variety of well-being programs designed to help individuals achieve work-life balance.

WORK LOCATION

This is a remote position. The Developer will work in a high-volume, business-critical environment supporting Workday and related applications and will interact with stakeholders across USC and with external vendors and partners.

SALARY & BENEFITS

The salary range for this position is $117,879.45-$130,000. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer alignment, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

Takes proactive measures to address H&S/E issues. When required, leads investigations and enforces compliance as applicable.

Addresses any employee compliance or performance issues through MCI's corrective action process.

  • Ensure policies and processes are established and adhered to ensure goals and objectives for all regulatory and legal requirements are met including organizational quality, environmental, health & safety programs.
  • Provides a progressive, interactive, innovative and collaborative work environment to maximize our ability to work as a team and make the organization more competitive and effective.

Requirements

  • Previous leadership experience with a minimum of 3-5 years' experience working within a tool fabrication environment, preferably in the transportation, automotive or bus industry. Machining Red Seal would be an asset.
  • Experience using mills, drills, lathes
  • Welding experience is preferred
  • Proficient computer skills required with MS Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, and Share Point.
  • Previous experience developing Jigs and Fixtures for high production process and industrial environments.

Location: Onsite in Doha, Qatar (relocation to Doha required)

The consultant will be responsible for the administration, operation, and ongoing support of the client's Oracle Hyperion EPM environment, including Essbase, Planning, FDQM, and HFM.   • Bachelor's degree, preferably in a related field, with more than five years of relevant experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Hyperion Essbase and Hyperion Planning
  • Expert-level proficiency in Smart View and the Essbase Excel Add-in
  • Expert-level proficiency in Reporting Studio writer support
  • Proven ability to support external entities' user community across Qatar
  • Project management skills, including experience leading system upgrades
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications
  • Fluent in Arabic (mandatory) with very good English communication skills

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer the Oracle Hyperion environment, including Hyperion Essbase, Hyperion Planning Server, Hyperion FDQM, and Hyperion HFM
  • Carry out Hyperion environment operations activities, including upgrades, backup and recovery, capacity management, production code deployment, and fail-over testing
  • Maintain production, test, DR, and development instances of the Hyperion infrastructure
  • Manage Hyperion application patch management and version control
  • Manage Hyperion environment security in line with best practices and compliance requirements
  • Maintain budgeting and planning allocations
  • Maintain data backups and plan/execute disaster recovery practices
  • Set up and maintain user access within Shared Services for Hyperion Planning and Essbase
  • Deploy and maintain financial data across the Hyperion EPM suite on an ongoing basis
  • Coordinate Hyperion FDMEE data loads from EBS

title: Stewardship Analyst
description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

Wellington's Stewardship & Sustainable Investment team plays a key role in bringing together our sustainable investment capabilities and the firm's stewardship activities, helping to enhance long-term value for our clients. We are seeking a Stewardship Analyst to join this collaborative team, which sits within the COO Group on our Investment Platform, as we seek to scale our capabilities across engagement, proxy voting and stewardship operations.

This role will support Wellington's stewardship activities by partnering with investment professionals to execute company engagements, inform proxy voting decisions, and advance research on governance and other financially material sustainability issues. The successful candidate will be highly collaborative and establish credibility across multiple teams to contribute to engagement prioritization, proxy analysis, stewardship reporting, and the scaling of stewardship processes to deliver strong long-term outcomes for clients.

Responsibilities

Company Engagement

  • Support the Stewardship Lead in the development and execution of thematic and issuer-specific engagement priorities.

  • Participate in and lead, where appropriate, engagements with company management and board directors in support of stewardship priorities and to inform proxy voting decisions.

  • Identify and communicate key insights, company responsiveness, and engagement outcomes.

  • Contribute to issuer-specific research, stewardship case studies and internal knowledge sharing that support the broader investment dialogue.

Proxy Voting

  • Analyze proxy ballot items across global markets and formulate voting recommendations consistent with Wellington's Proxy Voting Guidelines.

  • Incorporate company engagement history, investment research, governance practices, and market context into voting analysis, feeding back into development of voting guidelines

  • Support proxy voting operations, especially during peak proxy season, while helping improve the efficiency and quality of voting workflows.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and evolving governance practices across global markets.

Stewardship Operations

  • Maintain accurate engagement records and stewardship data to support reporting, measurement, and transparency.

  • Leverage data analytics and AI-enabled research tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency and quality of proxy voting analysis, engagement capture, and reporting.

  • Assist with embedding stewardship and sustainable investment capabilities in investor workflows

  • Support stewardship reporting and responses to stewardship-related RFI/RFPs through close collaboration with teams on the infrastructure and client platforms.

Essential Skills

  • Analytical acumen and research judgment – The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate company disclosures, governance practices, proxy materials, sustainability reporting, and market context to form thoughtful, evidence-based recommendations. Comfort working with qualitative and quantitative information and identifying the most decision-useful insights will be essential.

  • Stewardship and investment orientation – Successful candidates will bring a strong interest in corporate governance, stewardship, sustainability, and long-term investing. The ability to connect stewardship activities to investment relevance, client outcomes, and financially material issues will be important, along with sound judgment in assessing company practices and engagement opportunities.

  • Superior communication and collaboration skills – This role requires the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. The Stewardship Analyst will partner closely with investment professionals, stewardship colleagues, and teams across the Investment and Client Platforms, so strong relationship-building skills, humility, and a collaborative orientation are essential.

  • Process discipline and continuous improvement mindset – The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities, particularly during peak proxy season. A proactive approach to improving workflows, maintaining high-quality stewardship data, and adopting AI-enabled tools or other technology to enhance research, reporting, and engagement tracking will be highly valued.

Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law, Sustainability, Political Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

  • Approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience in investment stewardship, corporate governance, investment research, responsible investing, sustainability, consulting, investor relations, or another research-oriented role.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with data tools such as Power BI, Python, or other AI-enabled workflows is a plus.

  • Exceptional early-career candidates with outstanding analytical ability, writing skills, and demonstrated interest in corporate governance and investing will also be considered.

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

As an equal opportunity employer, Wellington Management ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, religion, creed, national origin, age, ancestry, disability (physical or mental), medical condition, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at GMWTalentOperations@wellington.com.

We strive to pay employees fairly and competitively across all levels and roles. Our approach to compensation considers all aspects of total compensation; all employees are eligible to receive salary, variable compensation, and benefits. USD 80,000 - 150,000

This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; role; skills and experience; certifications; and education. This range is an estimate, and further details on salary and total compensation aspects will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process.

Base salary is only one component of Wellington’s total compensation approach. Other rewards may include a discretionary Corporate Bonus and/ or Incentives, if eligible. In addition, we offer a comprehensive and high value benefit package to meet the unique needs of our employees and their families, and we are committed to fostering a flexible work environment that enables employees to thrive personally and professionally. title: Full Stack Django Developer (Frontend Focus) - Contract
description:
Position Summary

The Full Stack Django Developer (Frontend Focus) is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of the in-house software that Tayco's plant runs on, including label printing, assembly tracking, machine downtime reporting, and live production dashboards. This position owns the interface layer of these applications - everything shop floor users see and interact with - and works across the full stack to deliver features from model and view through to the rendered screen. As these systems are in use on every shift and are currently being expanded across the plant, this position also requires regular presence on the production floor to observe how the software is used, to train operators and supervisors, and to document existing and new processes.

Posting notice: This posting is for 1 vacancy for a 12-month contract position.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Own the interface layer of all shop floor applications, including page layout,
  • responsive behaviour, scanner and keyboard input handling, form usability, and error and empty state handling.
  • Develop and maintain a substantial JavaScript codebase (vanilla ES6, no framework and no build step), including scan handling, dynamic tables, live updates, and client- side validation.
  • Build and consume REST endpoints to move data between the Django backend and the screen, ensuring that failure cases - slow requests, failed requests, and empty responses - are handled properly.
  • Develop features end to end, from model, view, and queryset through to what is rendered for the user.
  • Build and maintain live production dashboards over Django Channels, including reconnection handling and stale state management.
  • Refactor existing JavaScript into shared, consistent modules, incrementally and without disrupting production use.
  • Spend time on the production floor observing how operators and supervisors use the software, and translate the problems observed into requirements.
  • Provide training to operators and supervisors on new features, and develop and maintain user-facing documentation as the software is rolled out to additional departments.
  • Document existing processes that are currently undocumented, and improve test coverage incrementally, without interrupting production.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools with sound judgement, reviewing what is generated, selecting which problems to delegate, and remaining accountable for every line of code submitted.
  • Perform various development and maintenance tasks as required.

Requirements

  • Must have post secondary education in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or 2-5 years of industry experience building web applications.
  • Must have strong JavaScript skills, and be able to take ownership of a large, JavaScript-heavy codebase written in vanilla ES6 with no framework and no build
  • step.
  • Must have a solid understanding of REST APIs, including designing endpoints, consuming them from the front end, and determining the correct behaviour when a request is slow, fails, or returns nothing.
  • Working knowledge of Django and intermediate Python required. Must be able to write a view, a model, a form, and a queryset without supervision; expert-level Django knowledge is not required.
  • Must have fluency with Bootstrap 5, and enough confidence with CSS to customize the framework rather than work around it.
  • Knowledge of Tayco's current stack is an asset: Django 5.2, PostgreSQL, Redis, Django Channels and Daphne, Bootstrap 5.3, vanilla ES6 with no build step, read- only ERP integration, and deployment to Windows Server through GitHub Actions. Experience with Django Channels or WebSockets, Redis, barcode or scanner-driven interfaces, manufacturing or warehouse software, user-facing documentation, accessibility work, or interface design is considered an asset.
  • Must be able to use AI-assisted development tools effectively and with judgement, including reviewing what is generated, knowing which problems to hand over, and being able to explain any line of code shipped.
  • Ability to improve and refactor code written by others, in small and safe increments. Ability to communicate clearly with people who are not technical, and to gather requirements from operators who describe a problem in their own words rather than as a specification.
  • Ability to teach and demonstrate software at the workstation, and to document procedures so that the following shift can work from them.
  • Ability to confirm requirements before building, recognizing that an incorrect assumption can cost a workstation an entire shift.
  • Ability to raise problems directly and constructively, including problems of internal origin.
  • Ability to recognize when an Interface is confusing or inefficient without being told. Ability to read and interpret written and oral instructions.
  • Must possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Must have good communication skills, and a positive and proactive attitude.
  • Required to have good organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and be able to prioritize workload.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical applications.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written and oral form.
  • Ability to deal with problems, involving several variables, in complex situations. Must have the capacity to make departmental decisions/recommendations that will improve the operating efficiency of the department.

COMPETENCIES

Adaptability Adapts and responds to changing conditions, priorities, technologies and requirements. Ability to comfortably collaborate in a variety of situations and with diverse individuals.

Communication Expresses and transmits information consistently and clearly, using active listening skills to understand feedback and summarize information.

Critical Thinking Analyzes and interprets data and information in order to develop conclusions. Able to identify current and future opportunities, challenges and risks.

Networking and Relationship Building Effectively builds constructive, friendly, professional relationships and networks with key contacts inside and outside the organization. Maintains partnerships that can provide information, assistance and support.

Planning and Organization Can set out goals and objectives and work plans to accomplish tasks.

Problem-Solving Possesses the ability to break a situation down into smaller pieces to identify key issues, figuring out cause and effect relationships in order to solve. Uses logic and analytical methods to come to realistic solution.

Initiative Ability to assess and take advantage of opportunities independently.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The working conditions described are representative of those an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to regularly access and move throughout the production floor and other work areas as required by the role.
  • Ability to attend and conduct presentations.
  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.
  • Overtime as required.

Salary Range : $65,000 to $70,000 Annually

Benefits

  • Active Social Committee with wonderful company culture
  • Active Inclusion, Diversity, Engagement, and Accessibility Committee with monthly initiatives to promote inclusivity

title: Product Manager
description:
ABOUT US:

Cervélo exists to Make Riders Faster. You'll see our bikes on the road, on the trail, and under some of the most elite athletes in the world. We're a small group of passionate riders, dedicated to delivering the best bikes in the world. We're headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, a sweet corner of Orange County where you can ride on and off road year-round. Cervélo bikes have won all three Grand Tours (the first bike in history to do so), our ambitions have never been higher, and we're looking for talented, driven people to join our team.

ABOUT YOU:

The Product Manager is responsible for managing the development, launch, and ongoing management of assigned products, working within the broader product strategy to deliver products that meet consumer, brand, performance, and business objectives.

The Product Manager translates consumer, market, competitive, and business insights into defined product requirements and manages products through the development process from concept to launch. This role works closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Quality, and Finance to ensure products are developed and commercialized effectively.

This role involves being a key cross-functional contributor, responsible for driving product decisions, managing priorities, coordinating development activities, and ensuring teams remain aligned throughout the product development process.

This role will require you to be onsite at Cervelo’s HQ in Aliso Viejo, CA.

WHAT DOES YOUR DAY JOB LOOK LIKE?

  • Manage product development from concept through launch, ensuring products meet defined performance, quality, cost, and timing objectives.

title: Statistical/Population Geneticist — Immunology Research
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Function: Immunology Informatics / Human Genetics

Level: R5-R6

Location: Indy or Boston

About the Role

The Immunology Informatics team integrates human genetics into drug discovery and development across the autoimmune disease spectrum (rheumatology, gastroenterology, and dermatology). We are seeking a statistical or population geneticist to strengthen our target identification and validation efforts by applying rigorous quantitative genetics methods — including Mendelian randomization, GWAS interpretation, fine mapping co-localization, and multi-omic integration — to identify, prioritize and de-risk therapeutic targets across the immunology pipeline.

This role sits at the interface of human genetics, translational biology, and drug development strategy, working closely with target discovery, translational medicine, statistical, and bioinformatics colleagues, as well as external partners.

What You'll Do

Target Evaluation & Genetic Evidence Assessment

  • Lead systematic genetic evidence reviews for existing and emerging immunology drug targets, synthesizing GWAS, exome/whole-genome sequencing, and rare-variant data to assess causal support and directionality (loss-of-function vs. gain-of-function phenotype concordance with therapeutic hypothesis).
  • Build and maintain target evaluation frameworks that score genetic evidence quality, effect direction, and development-stage relevance across a target portfolio.
  • Interrogate and interpret summary and individual levels data from public and licensed genetic resources (e.g., Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, UK Biobank, AllofUs, FinnGen) to support go/no-go and prioritization decisions for drug targets
  • Propose novel drug targets with strong human causal evidence for autoimmune diseases.
  • Make decision enabling judgements on drug target quality strong scientific rationale

Population Genetics, Mendelian Randomization, Causal Inference

  • Design, execute, and critically evaluate evidence from large population-scale datasets using Mendelian Randomization and other methods to test causal relationships between genetic variamts, biomarkers/proteins and immune-mediated disease outcomes.
  • Assess genetic instrument validity for Mendelian Randomization, pleiotropy, and sensitivity of MR findings (e.g., MR-Egger, weighted median, colocalization) and communicate limitations clearly to immunologists.
  • Collaborate with external genetics partners and academic collaborators on specific genetics programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Translate complex genetic and statistical findings into clear, decision-relevant summaries for target discovery teams, translational scientists, and portfolio governance.
  • Contribute genetics-informed input to target nomination packages, competitive intelligence, and program strategy documents.
  • Represent statistical genetics perspective in cross-functional target review forums.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in statistical genetics, population genetics, genetic epidemiology, biostatistics, computational biology, or a related quantitative field (or M.D, M.S. with equivalent industry experience).
  • Demonstrated experience working on large-scale population datasets, Mendelian randomization (MR) methodology and causal inference from human genetic datasets
  • Strong proficiency in R, ideally within a tidyverse-based workflow; comfort with reproducible, version-controlled analysis (Git); basic knowledge of PLINK or other tools to manipulate large genotype datasets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience interrogating large-scale genetics/genomics databases (e.g. UK Biobank, AllofUS, Open Targets,) and their APIs.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using fine-mapping, and colocalization approaches for GWAS summary statistics to refine association signals and identify causal genetic variants.
  • Ability to critically evaluate statistical/analytical pipelines for genetic analysis and communicate methodological trade-offs to interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience in immunology/immune-mediated population genetics.
  • Experience integrating multi-omics with genetics data, including pQTL or eqTL analysis.
  • Familiarity with drug target identification/validation criteria and workflows in a pharmaceutical or biotech R&D setting.
  • Experience collaborating with external genetics/data partners or academic consortia.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Providing a defensible, well-documented genetic evidence assessment that underpins target prioritization decisions across the immunology portfolio.
  • Proposing novel targets within the immunology space
  • Ensuring that MR and other causal-inference methods are sound, appropriately caveated, and actionable for non-specialist stakeholders.
  • Establishing strong working relationships with target discovery, translational medicine, and external genetics collaborators.

title: Broista – Covina, CA
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real, this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, high-energy, and physically demanding. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering next-level service. As the face of Dutch Bros, you’ll connect with customers, hustle with heart, and bring positive energy onto every single shift.

Who You Are:

  • A people person who thrives on connection and loves making someone’s day.
  • Adaptable and quick; you can handle a rush and keep the kindness rolling.
  • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.
  • Positive and considerate; even when it gets busy or during inclement weather you continue to show up.
  • Committed to growth and always looking for ways to improve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Engage. Greet every customer with a smile, make genuine connections, and ensure every visit is full of kindness & fun.
  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values: radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.
  • Stay Fast & Focused. Work efficiently to craft high-quality drinks while keeping up with the hustle of a busy shop.
  • Be Reliable. Show up on time, communicate your availability, and be ready to roll when your shift starts.
  • Keep it Clean. Maintain a tidy workspace and follow food safety standards.

What to Expect:

  • Fast-paced, high-energy environment. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and handling a steady flow of customers for up to 10-hour shifts!
  • Crew-first mentality. We support each other, have everyone’s backs, and get the job done together.
  • Weather-ready. Be prepared for all conditions; rain or shine. Don’t worry we’ve got Dutch gear to help!
  • Some heavy lifting. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs (talk about a workout).
  • Reliable transportation. You’ll need to show up on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.
  • Training & Development. We’ll set you up for success with training, certifications, and knowledge tests to ensure you meet the Dutch Bros standards.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • We’ve got your back. Competitive pay & tips, opportunities for tuition reimbursement, and career growth within the shops, HQ, Emerging Talent Program, and warehouse/fulfillment opportunities.
  • Perks on perks. Free drinks & food on shift, exclusive Dutch Bros swag and giveaway items, and a work environment like no other.
  • Make a difference. Every cup you serve supports local & national communities and brings people together.
  • Room to grow. We believe in pouring into our people; Broista today, leader tomorrow! We’re set to double in size within the next three years which means a ton of growth opportunities for you.

At Dutch Bros, our culture is unmatched. We’re a fun, tight-knit crew that supports each other and creates connections you won’t find anywhere else. Ready to make a massive difference together?!

Compensation:

Up to $23.50 per hour

Number includes an average tip of $3.50 per hour. What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2025 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

JOB PURPOSE:

The Expert Oracle ERP Application Developer will design, develop, enhance, and support Oracle

E-Business Suite (R12.2.x) applications. The role requires strong technical skills in Oracle ERP,

Oracle APEX, and Oracle OAF, in addition to advanced PL/SQL and integration knowledge. The

developer will collaborate with functional teams, deliver high-quality solutions, and provide

technical leadership within the ERP environment.

Description

1- Application Development & Customization

• Develop and customize Oracle ERP (R12.2.x) components using:

o Oracle APEX (Mandatory)

o Oracle OAF (Mandatory)

o Oracle Forms , Reports (10g/12c) and BI Publisher

o Oracle Workflow Builder

• Create and maintain:

o PL/SQL packages, functions, procedures, and APIs

o Reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions (RICE)

o Custom concurrent programs

• Support development for new modules, system enhancements, and upgrades.

2- Functional & Technical Support

• Provide technical support for key Oracle ERP modules such as:

o Financials: AP, AR, GL, FA

o Supply Chain: PO, INV, OM

o HRMS/Payroll (as applicable)

• Troubleshoot system issues and provide timely resolutions.

• Analyze business requirements and design scalable solutions.

• Support patching, cloning, and maintenance tasks during R12.2 online patching (adop).

3- Integration & APIs

• Develop integrations using:

o REST/SOAP web services

o Oracle public APIs & Interface tables

• Develop secure data exchange processes with external systems (APEX/OAF-based solutions included).

4- Performance & Quality Assurance

• Conduct PL/SQL optimization and tuning.

• Perform code reviews and ensure compliance with EBS development standards.

• Prepare technical documents: MD050, MD070, TE020, and deployment guides.

5- Collaboration & Leadership

• Work closely with functional consultants and technical teams.

• Mentor junior developers and ensure use of best practices.

• Participate actively in system design and architecture discussions.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.

Experience

• 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Oracle ERP application development (R12.1/R12.2).

• Strong experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12.2.x, including online patching.

Mandatory Technical Skills

• Oracle APEX – Advanced development

• Oracle OAF – Customizations & Extensions

• PL/SQL (expert-level)

• Oracle Forms / Reports

• BI Publisher & XML Publisher

• Oracle Workflow

• Unix/Linux shell scripting

• Understanding of EBS architecture, file system, patches, and adop cycles

Preferred Skills

• Knowledge of:

o Oracle SOA / Integration Cloud (OIC)

o REST/SOAP API integration

o Oracle ADF

o Version control (Git/SVN)

• Experience working in Agile environments.

BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Leadership and mentoring capabilities.

• Strong ownership and commitment to quality.

title: Executive Services Co-op
description:
BAIN CAPITAL OVERVIEW

With approximately $215 billion of assets under management, Bain Capital is one of the world’s leading private investment firms. We create lasting impact for our investors, teams, businesses, and the communities in which we live. Over four decades we have strategically grown our platform to focus on Private Equity, Growth & Venture, Capital Solutions, Credit, and Real Assets. Today, our team includes 1,985+ employees in 24 offices on four continents.

We partner differently to help people and companies embrace possibility and realize potential. Founded as a private partnership in 1984, we have fostered a culture of innovation, entrepreneurialism, and agility, empowering our people to define and own their career trajectories. Today, our partnership approach enables us to pursue strategic growth, build enduring relationships with a robust external network, and collaborate across our integrated platform to connect the deep and diverse expertise that unlocks breakthrough insights.

Our people are the heart of our advantage. Colleagues at all levels have a seat at the table as they tackle business challenges with a principal investor mindset. By asking incisive questions, respectfully challenging one another, and remaining intellectually agile, we work together to achieve exceptional outcomes.

PARTNER SERVICES OVERVIEW

The Bain Capital Partner Services Group provides Partners with confidential, professional services including: consolidating financial information; identifying personal investment opportunities; investment diligence; performance reporting of personal investments; loan program management; philanthropic services and managing various other personal services. The Partner Services Group is also the main point of contact for third party family office service providers and vendors. Members of the team regularly collaborate with members of nearly every internal department in the firm, including investment professionals, other internal finance departments, tax, legal, HR, compliance and IT.

Co-Op responsibilities will include the following:

  • Initial point of contact for inbound communications to the Partner Services group

Job Description:

Are you a skilled legal professional looking for a dynamic and rewarding career in the title insurance industry? Old Republic Title is seeking a Claims Counsel to evaluate, manage, and resolve title insurance claims nationwide. If you have strong analytical abilities, sound legal judgment, and enjoy solving complex issues in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.

This opportunity is ideal for attorneys with 3-5 years of legal experience who are looking to build expertise in title insurance, real estate, and claims management while working for a stable and respected industry leader. Job Summary:

Assists in performing a variety of nursing care services for patients.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Receives patient care assignment from the registered nurse (RN) in charge. Initiates delegated tasks based on demonstrated competence in performing nursing activities for specific patient age group served.
  • Collects and documents data for the admission assessment and reassessment at specific times for patient population. Documents and provides appropriate data to the licensed nurse for analysis and validation of patient’s response to care or treatment and when significant change occurs in the patient’s condition.
  • Relaying information via charting and communicating to team members.
  • Informs licensed nurse of any changes in patient condition/needs, of patient complaints, and of patient/significant other educational needs.
  • Answers patients’ calls for help, takes their vital signs, and monitors their behavior and physical condition for progress or deterioration. Assists with baths, ambulating, feeding, skin care, personal and oral hygiene and making occupied and unoccupied beds. Performs dressing changes, enemas, ostomy care, toileting, turning, cough and deep breathing, catheter care, collection of biological specimens, measuring and recording intake and output of fluids.
  • Prepares patients for discharge and accompanies them upon dismissal as indicated.
  • Stocks and maintains supplies and equipment in keeping with patient care needs and cost containment.
  • Assists with delegated clerical duties such as answering telephones, relaying messages, transcription of physician orders, preparing and organizing the patient's medical record.
  • Orients new patients and significant others to the nursing unit.
  • Performs mechanical and manual operation of equipment as recommended in user's manual, with ability to recognize common mechanical problems and initiate appropriate corrective action.
  • May perform point of care testing according to policies and procedures.
  • Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION

  • Education equivalency for licensing

EXPERIENCE

  • No experience required

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Constant standing and walking.
  • Frequent use of hearing and speech to share information through oral communication.
  • Frequent use of hearing to distinguish body sounds and/or hear alarms, malfunctioning machinery, etc.

title: Branch Outreach Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:

Canadian Parents for French (CPF) Alberta is seeking a dynamic and highly organized Branch Outreach Coordinator to support the delivery of programs, events, communications, and branch operations. Working closely with the Executive Director, Board of Directors, chapters, volunteers, and community partners, the successful candidate will play a key role in advancing CPF Alberta's mission and supporting French-second-language learning opportunities throughout the province.


Key Responsibilities:

Event and Program Coordination

  • Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of special projects, events, and activities, including:
    • Annual General Meeting (AGM)
    • Parent engagement events
    • Family-focused events and activities
    • Student events and programs
    • Advocacy initiatives and events
  • Manage event registrations, participant communications, and payment processing.
  • Coordinate event logistics, vendor communications, and onsite support as required.

Membership and Chapter Support

  • Serve as a liaison between the Branch and local chapters.
  • Maintain and coordinate membership records and chapter communications.
  • Support chapter engagement initiatives and facilitate the distribution of information and resources.

Communications and Resource Management

  • Respond to general inquiries and correspondence, directing communications to appropriate staff members when required.
  • Coordinate the distribution and inventory of promotional materials, brochures, posters, and other CPF resources to chapters, schools, and community stakeholders.
  • Assist with outreach and promotional activities that support CPF Alberta's programs and objectives.

Reporting and Administration

  • Maintain branch statistics and assist with reporting requirements, including reports required by funding partners such as Canadian Heritage.
  • Coordinate regular staff meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, minute taking, and calendar management.
  • Provide administrative support to the Executive Director, Board of Directors, and Board committees as assigned.
  • Assist with the effective administration, operation, and maintenance of branch office functions.

Organizational Support and Representation

  • Prioritize tasks and projects to ensure alignment with the strategic direction established by the Board of Directors and Executive Director.
  • Represent CPF Alberta at CPF Network meetings, community events, and partner meetings as directed.
  • Contribute positively to a collaborative and team-oriented work environment.


Qualifications and Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in both English and French, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Residence within the Greater Edmonton Area.
  • Eligibility to work legally in Canada.
  • A valid Class 5 driver's licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a current Police Information Check with Vulnerable Sector Screening.
  • Knowledge of Alberta's education system, including familiarity with French Immersion and Core French programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a hybrid or remote work environment.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in:

  • Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
  • Zoom
  • Canva
  • Jotform
  • CyberImpact
  • Online databases, registration systems, and digital collaboration tools

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to travel occasionally within Alberta and across Canada as required.
  • Availability to attend occasional evening and weekend meetings or events with advance notice.
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment, including printers, scanners, shredders, laminators, and related equipment.
  • Comfortable supporting and participating in advocacy initiatives that align with CPF Alberta's mission.


Employment Details:

  • Full-time position (37.5 hours per week).
  • Hybrid/remote work option available.
  • Typical working hours are between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., with flexibility based on organizational needs.
  • Occasional evening and weekend work is required.
  • Travel expenses, approved mileage, and per diems will be reimbursed in accordance with organizational policies.

Compensation and Benefits:

Upon successful completion of the probationary period, employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Extended health benefits
  • Dental coverage
  • Disability insurance
  • Employer-matched RRSP contributions

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter to: executivedirector@ab-nwt.cpf.ca

For additional information regarding this opportunity, please contact: (780) 860-1248

Please note:

Canadian Parents for French (CPF) is a national network of volunteers that values French as an integral part of Canada and is dedicated to promoting and creating French-second-language learning opportunities for young Canadians.

title: Field Service Foreman
description:

title: Advisor Chemistry
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Organization Overview

At Lilly, we serve an extraordinary purpose. We make a difference for people around the globe by discovering, developing and delivering medicines that help them live longer, healthier, more active lives. Not only do we deliver breakthrough medications, but you also can count on us to develop creative solutions to support communities through philanthropy and volunteerism.

Protomer is a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Co. based in Pasadena, CA. The team operates as a group within Lilly Research Laboratories (LRL). LRL is focused on the discovery and development of new therapeutics for the treatment of a plethora of diseases. The scientists in LRL work cross-functionally between therapeutic target area disciplines, including Diabetes, Heart Failure, Renal, Neuroscience, ASCVD, Incretins and Insulins. The team at Protomer is working on responsive biotherapeutics that can be controlled using small molecule modulators. We are currently expanding the team to advance several programs, including responsive siRNA and ASOs using sensing elements, and are looking for a research scientist with a proven record of accomplishment in chemistry, biochemistry, synthesis, bioconjugations, and purification/characterization of therapeutic compounds of interest.

The ideal candidate will have a degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, biochemistry, biology, or a related field, as well as in-depth understanding of basic biochemistry and chemistry techniques and experience with development, validation, and implementation of experiments in a biomedical research setting. Ideal candidate will have great working knowledge of synthetic routes for RNA molecules that can be conjugated or synthesized with small molecule or short peptides. The applicant must be a fast-learning, task-oriented, and self-motivated person who can perform detailed work with minimal supervision. A requirement of this role is to work well as a team player in a fast-paced research setting. The applicant will be responsible for synthesis, bioconjugation, purification, and characterization of compounds of interest. The successful candidate will actively participate and present in team meetings and is expected to contribute to the team’s progress and success.

Demonstrated ability to make decisions in the midst of ambiguity, seeking appropriate level of information from Protomer leadership and enabling workforce to execute for and contribute to Protomer team’s strategic priorities.

Open, transparent and able to communicate equally well with employees, team members and cross-functional and/or senior leadership. Team oriented mindset, pleasant to work with and a leader that develops next generation talent as well as delivers results.

Ability to think strategically, actively identifying gaps in competencies or capabilities within the organization and taking initiative to drive continuous improvement across Protomer.

Responsibilities:

· Work closely with the Protomer team to accomplish team objectives and research milestones

· Use knowledge and technical expertise to complement and enable core capabilities and help drive development of preclinical and clinical candidates

· Purify and characterize compounds using HPLC, FPLC, and various biochemical methods

· Introduce and maintain state-of-the-art technologies with respect to peptide therapeutics, including developing and implementing assays and maintaining critical instruments.

· Perform data analysis. Critically evaluate data and results and troubleshoot experiments.

· Demonstrable ability to function independently, work within a team-oriented lab environment, and work within cross-functional project teams.

· Maintain accurate record keeping, perform independent data analysis, and report data in written and oral formats and retain excellent electronic lab notes.

· Perform work in compliance with Lilly Research Policies.

· Demonstrate proactive and flexible behaviors and develop skills for competency in conducting independent research projects.

Basic Qualifications:

· PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field with relevant graduate or post-graduate level research experience.

Additional Skills/Preferences:

· Responsibilities will reflect the level of experience and competency of the candidate and can span from early research and development execution to overseeing larger efforts depending on experience

· Proven ability to work in a flexible, team-oriented environment.

· Experience with standard biochemistry techniques in a graduate level academic research setting and preferably in an industry setting.

· Individuals with significant industry experience will be considered and responsibilities will reflect the level of experience of the candidate.

· Experience in the development and validation of in vitro biochemical and data evaluation, especially in the areas of cardiorenal and metabolic diseases.

· Strong communication skills and experience presenting data in a team environment.

· Strong relationship-building and interaction skills with peers and management.

Additional Information:

Some domestic and international travel is anticipated and expected. Work is on-site and the team is located in Pasadena, California.

title: Solution Architect & Development Team Lead — React / Node.js / SaaS Architecture
description:
We're hiring a Solution Architect who will also act as our development team's lead — someone who proposes real technical solutions and then stays hands-on to help build them. This is not a role for someone who wants to hand off a diagram and walk away. You'll lead a small team (a Senior Software Engineer and a Junior Developer), make the architecture calls, and still be writing and reviewing code yourself.


We want someone who thinks in terms of solutions delivered, not hours logged — who's willing to go the extra mile when a project needs it, and who's spent real time at a well-known Pakistani software house doing both hands-on development and solution architecture work.



  • Propose end-to-end solution architecture for new projects and features across our portfolio — websites, SaaS-style solutions, and backend systems (including data-heavy builds like our Parts Blue vendor-catalog backend)
  • Stay hands-on as lead developer — writing and reviewing production code in React and Node.js, not just producing architecture diagrams
  • Lead and mentor a small development team, setting the technical direction and quality bar for their work
  • Make the call on stack, tooling, and system design trade-offs, and stand behind those decisions
  • Partner directly with our Technical Project Manager to scope, estimate, and sequence work across multiple concurrent projects
  • Own code review standards and the overall technical quality/reliability bar for the team's output
  • Take ownership of problems beyond your immediate ticket when that's what it takes to actually ship
  • 7+ years of software development experience (10+ years ideal), including meaningful time in a Solution Architect or technical leadership capacity — not purely an individual-contributor track
  • That experience should include time at a known, well-regarded Pakistani software house
  • Continued, active hands-on development — you should still want to be in the code, not just reviewing it from a distance
  • Strong, demonstrable React and Node.js expertise
  • Real experience architecting SaaS-style, multi-tenant, or multi-client web solutions
  • Comfort owning both frontend and backend architecture decisions
  • Familiarity with modern tooling — Sanity, Vercel, Supabase, Cursor, GitHub (openness to newer AI-assisted tools like Lovable is a plus)
  • A track record of leading or mentoring developers
  • An outcomes-first mindset — you measure success by what got delivered, not hours logged
  • Strong communication skills, including with non-technical stakeholders

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.


  • Remote working opportunity
  • Opportunity to work across multiple products and projects.
  • Exposure to modern technologies and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Opportunity to work closely with technical and project leadership.

title: Center for Inclusive Excellence in Teaching (CIET) Postdoctoral Center Fellow
description:
Summary

The Postdoctoral Center Fellow will contribute toward evidenced-based pedagogical and curricular projects that support faculty engagement in professional development and teaching.

Description

The Center for Inclusive Excellence in Teaching (CIET) at the College of the Holy Cross invites applications for a Postdoctoral Center Fellow to contribute toward evidence-based pedagogical and curricular projects that support faculty engagement in professional development in teaching, to begin as soon as possible. The Fellowship provides an opportunity to work with faculty across the disciplines in a small liberal arts college committed to inclusive excellence in teaching. The CIET Fellow will be expected to contribute to the Center’s core programming and will be mentored and supported in publishing scholarly work based on their contributions to the Center’s programs. They will have the opportunity to learn about program development, qualitative assessment, the scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL), and other areas that can be carried forward into a range of academic and non-academic careers. The CIET Fellow will teach one course per year and be provided with a professional development stipend.

This position offers full benefits and a starting salary of $70,000. The appointment will be for an initial period of two years and may be eligible for renewal for one additional year, subject to review based on the Center's ongoing priorities and needs. To learn more about faculty life at the College and in the Worcester area, candidates are encouraged to see the Resources for Prospective Faculty on our Faculty Openings page.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Developing and/or leading workshops and Center resources on a range of topics such as course and syllabus design, learning-centered assignments, and critical pedagogy.

  • Contributing to the development of the Center’s Inclusive excellence in teaching and learning “curriculum.”

  • Developing a SoTL project aligned with the Center’s mission

Qualifications:

  • PhD or equivalent doctoral degree (not ABD) required by the start of the appointment

  • 1 or more years of experience as a graduate teaching fellow at a Center for teaching and learning or equivalent experience.

  • One to two years of teaching experience at the college or university level.

  • Demonstrable professional and pedagogical commitment to equity, and a passion for cultivating a vibrant, inclusive teaching and learning community.

  • Demonstrable understanding of inclusive pedagogy, assessment design, and course development.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to engage various audiences.

  • Empathetic, active listening skills and open-minded engagement.

  • Strong collaboration skills.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience developing and/or facilitating pedagogical workshops.

  • Implementation of inclusive pedagogy, course design, and development into program development (such as faculty workshops, teaching consultations, conference workshops, invited presentations).

  • Knowledge of models of faculty development.

Application Instructions

Please submit the following:

  • A current curriculum vitae

  • A cover letter addressing your qualifications for the position and why this position is ideal for this stage of your career

  • unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts

  • The names and contact details of three referees (referees will only be contacted for shortlisted candidates)

  • A statement of your teaching philosophy

The College of the Holy Cross uses Interfolio to collect all faculty job applications electronically. Please submit all application materials to [insert link].

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Initial interviews of selected candidates will take place on Zoom, followed by campus visits for finalists. For further information, please contact Kathy Takayama (ktakayama@holycross.edu).

The Provost’s Office supports the Association of American Universities’ principles on preventing sexual harassment in academia. Accordingly, all finalists will be asked to attest that they are not currently under investigation for sexual misconduct and that there are no substantiated findings of sexual misconduct against them in any previous position—or, if such findings exist, to provide a full explanation. The candidate selected for an offer will also be asked to provide written consent for the release of personnel information from their prior employer.

For applicants who may require visa sponsorship: The College supports new faculty in pursuing an appropriate visa or other immigration status consistent with their qualifications and the responsibilities of the position. Because several pathways may be available, the College works with candidates who are offered positions to determine the most appropriate option. Please note, however, the College does not support H1-B visa petitions that are subject to the payment of an additional $100,000 fee. The College, where appropriate, will support H-1B petitions that are not subject to the $100,000 fee.


The College also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the hiring process in compliance with law. Please contact Human Resources for questions or to request an accommodation via email at hr@holycross.edu, or by calling 508-793-3391.

·Candidate for bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

Expected Hourly Rate of Pay $24.00 – $26.00

title: Analista Contable

Analista Contable

Durán, Guayas, Ecuador
