• Maintains a working knowledge of current computer systems used in clinical areas.
• Understands and utilizes the telephone/pager systems, including text paging staff, call system and emergency response system.
• Provides proactive instruction and time expectations to patient and family.
• Communicates patient and family status difficulties and concerns to appropriate staff.
• Attends mandatory training and education sessions, completes mandatory annual competency assessments and follows Institute policies.
• Accepts additional responsibilities based on the changing needs of patients, families, staff and unit.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

o Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.
o Ability to work as an effective member of an interdisciplinary team.

o Demonstrates proficiency in technical skills.

No

Yes, all ages.

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

title: Senior Systems Integration and Test Engineer, Platform Introduction
description:
Who we are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Systems Integration and Test Engineer to own how new vehicle platforms enter our fleet. In this role, you will take a new platform variant, sensor, or compute generation from first article to fleet release, owning the integration sequence, the validation criteria, and the documented correlation between bench results and vehicle behavior. You will turn what you learn on the first builds into the procedures, checks, and test coverage that make the next set of vehicles routine. The role spans multiple vehicle platforms with different hardware, compute, and software, and requires regular time in the garage and around vehicles.

What you’ll do

  • Platform introduction. Own first integration and bring-up for new platform variants, sensor generation, compute generation, and power or network architecture change.
  • First article to repeatable. Turn a one-off build into a commissioning procedure covering firmware, calibration, sign-offs, and autonomy software integration, written so a technician can execute.
  • Validation criteria. Define and run the vehicle-level checks a new platform passes before it runs a release.
  • Bench to vehicle correlation. Own the documented relationship between bench results and vehicle behavior for each platform.
  • Calibration, timing, and data integrity. Own multimodal calibration, time synchronization, and the integrity of the sensor to compute path on new platforms.
  • System debugging. Lead debugging on failures that cross mechanical, electrical, firmware, network, and autonomy boundaries, and stay on them until the root cause is established.
  • Documentation and standards. Write the integration guides, troubleshooting trees, and go or no-go criteria the technician team and other engineers work from, and hold internal teams and suppliers to conventions for labeling, documentation, and configuration control.

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field required.
  • 6+ years in systems integration, diagnostics, or hardware and software interface engineering on vehicles.
  • L4 program or production ADAS experience.
  • A track record of diagnosing failures that spanned hardware and software, with specific examples where you established the root cause.
  • Ability to correlate hardware symptoms and video evidence with telemetry and bus data into a concrete timeline.
  • Sensor-level troubleshooting depth on cameras, lidar, radar, GNSS and IMU, including timing failure modes.
  • Strong working knowledge of vehicle networks and diagnostics, including CAN, CAN FD, Automotive Ethernet, and DTCs, and how failures present at each layer.
  • Python and command line log analysis at the level of building production tools.
  • Automated triage or anomaly detection built over fleet data.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms and with log management at fleet scale.
  • Working experience with cloud storage and databases for telemetry: object storage, SQL, and time series or NoSQL stores.
  • Experience with a data collection or logging fleet, particularly diagnosing data path problems at volume.
  • Ability to work onsite five days a week in San Francisco, with periodic travel to test sites.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

title: Director, FLC Healthcare
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

The Healthcare Risk Management & Advisory (HRMA) practice is a high-performing team that works across both corporate engagements and litigation matters to deliver data-driven solutions to our clients. The healthcare industry is one of the largest, most dynamic, and complex sectors of the world economy and the HRMA team delivers strategic, analytical, financial, data mining and operational expertise through teams who understand the unique industry and regulatory environment in which our clients operate.

We serve clients across the healthcare continuum, including health systems, payors, and life sciences companies, as well as the law firms, banks, and private equity firms with whom they do business. We provide these clients with operational consulting and advisory services that are designed to help them optimize their performance and respond to strategic, operational, regulatory and financial challenges in an industry undergoing unprecedented change. Our multi-disciplinary team is comprised of consultants with expertise in data analytics, finance, accounting, economics, information technology and healthcare operations and regulations, and includes former healthcare executives and medical practitioners all of whom are focused on delivering meaningful results in order to manage change, mitigate risk, ensure compliance, resolve disputes, execute significant business transactions and improve performance.

As a Director, you will be partnered frequently with subject matter experts, giving the unique opportunity to work with a diverse set of clients as well as engage with a team of economists, strategy and transformation consultants, technologists, or corporate finance professionals across the FTI organization.

Example projects include:

  • Supporting multinational pharmaceuticals and life sciences companies improve operational performance and regulatory compliance through the development of bespoke analytics.

  • Supporting the country’s largest healthcare providers and payers respond to government investigations through a combination of deep subject matter expertise and complex data analysis

  • Creating systematic process to perform extensive analysis of decades of transactional data from numerous source systems to develop flexible models that can support counsel with strategic decisions about ongoing litigation

  • Developing a suite of operational dashboards with defined KPIs to allow the executive teams of healthcare and life sciences clients better track and manage the business

What You’ll Do

You will be responsible for delivering day-to-day data analytics services to our clients. A Director provides clients with industry specific analytics solutions through complex data-intensive analyses. A Director will require a deep understanding of relationships among multiple internal and external data sources, complex modelling, and understanding of the healthcare regulatory framework under which our clients operate. Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Managing the lifecycle of entire projects by effectively delegating responsibilities to junior team members, managing the client relationship, and executing on the statement of work.

  • Designing and managing complex data models including both external and internal client data to facilitate analysis

  • Interacting on a day-to-day basis with FTI team members, client personnel and advisors, typically serving as client day-to-day contact leader

  • Overseeing creation of project documentation, visualizations and written analyses, reports, or presentations

  • Nimbly juggling multiple client and internal priorities and switching between tasks, sometimes in a high-pressure environment

  • Developing and adhering to project budgets and timelines. Assist in project staffing decisions

  • Coaching and mentoring younger team members

  • Participate in business development efforts including proposals, collateral development and identification of new service offerings. Participate in business development meetings with clients. Develop and maintain professional relationships with current and prior clients

  • Participation in and delivery of FTI’s extensive internal and external training opportunities to help build your own skillset as well as develop new capabilities to be leveraged for our clients

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • 5+ years of relevant post-graduate experience

  • Experience managing multiple workstreams/projects, delegating responsibilities to junior team members, and managing client relationships

  • Subject Matter Expertise within healthcare compliance, government healthcare programs, statistical analysis or industry

  • Ability to effectively communicate findings and expertise to various stakeholders and/or public presentations

  • Demonstrated ability to build lasting client relationships and expand business opportunities

  • Support of Expert testifiers: report drafting, writing, document review, industry research

  • Ability to travel to clients and FTI office(s) as needed

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI

  • Experience using SQL and Python to collate, transform and analyze data

  • Experience collecting, aggregating and standardizing data through web scraping, PDF parsing, etc.

  • Proficiency with a wide range of data science concepts including natural language processing, statistical analysis, regression, clustering and various algorithms or predictive models

  • Knowledge of data governance and data privacy best practices

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our Software Engineers specialize in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Define and influence the direction of a small team, leveraging your subject-matter expertise in target tracking and state estimation.
  • Architect, maintain, and evolve complex software systems, refactoring existing codebases to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Prototype and deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for tracking, multi-sensor data fusion, and state estimation in agile, iterative development environments.
  • Develop high-performance Rust software for real-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.
  • Design and implement robust filters, estimators, and probabilistic reasoning systems that enable actionable insights from noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete sensor data.
  • Apply software design patterns and architectural best practices to manage technical debt and guide the evolution of production systems over time.
  • Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate the benefits of our technology.
  • Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including real-time tracking and sensor fusion.
  • Integrate tracking and estimation technologies into the broader software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.
  • Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues and end-users.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience & a Bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, or other technical field (advanced degree strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated experience managing and evolving software architecture in production environments, including refactoring legacy systems and managing technical debt.
  • At least 2+ years working on a single codebase or product, maintaining and expanding it as requirements evolved.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, architectural principles, and best practices for building maintainable, scalable systems (beyond basic syntax proficiency).
  • Proficiency in algorithm design, software development, and statistical modeling; experience with Rust and Python
  • Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, probability, and stochastic processes.
  • Familiarity with big data pipelines, NoSQL databases, and the efficient handling of large-scale sensor data.
  • Ability to engineer robust systems for estimation theory, adaptive filtering, controls, and complex signal environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience refactoring and modernizing Rust codebases in production environments.
  • Track record of architectural decision-making and technical leadership on long-lived projects.
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or the broader Rust ecosystem.
  • Experience with concurrent and parallel programming patterns in Rust.
  • Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.
  • Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).
  • Knowledge of signal processing techniques for interpreting diverse sensor data (e.g., radar, lidar, EO/IR)

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: This is an onsite role based at Nextiva’s Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048). Working together onsite strengthens how we operate, enabling faster decisions, clearer communication, and stronger execution, so you can make a greater impact and move work forward with speed and clarity.

In-Office Expectation: This role is expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week, as required by the business. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity.

Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (UI)

The Senior Software Engineer – Frontend is a hands-on individual contributor role for an experienced frontend engineer with strong technical expertise, ownership mindset, and a collaborative approach to building scalable web applications. This role is responsible for contributing to the development, modernization, and optimization of our frontend platform while actively delivering high-quality production code.

As a strong contributor, you will work on complex frontend initiatives, participate in technical design discussions, and help improve the scalability, reliability, performance, and usability of our applications. You will collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineering, and QA teams to deliver impactful, user-centered experiences aligned with business goals.

You will contribute to frontend best practices through code reviews, architecture discussions, testing strategies, and engineering standards. You will also support and mentor junior engineers while continuously growing your own technical expertise within a fast-paced, product-driven engineering environment.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building modern frontend applications, solving technical challenges, collaborating across teams, and growing toward advanced technical leadership.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (UI) to contribute to the evolution of our web applications and support Nextiva’s mission of delivering exceptional customer experiences through a unified, modern platform powered by AI and automation.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the rebuild and modernization of existing web applications to improve performance and user experience

  • Collaborate closely with design teams to translate UI/UX concepts into scalable, high-quality interfaces

  • Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance React-based frontend code

  • Participate in end-to-end feature delivery, from design through deployment

  • Contribute to frontend engineering standards through code reviews, testing, and engineering best practices

  • Debug application issues, identify bottlenecks, and improve frontend performance

  • Work with CI/CD pipelines and modern frontend development workflows

  • Evaluate and implement modern frontend tools and libraries where appropriate

  • Ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability of frontend applications

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, backend, QA, and design

  • Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend architecture initiatives

  • Participate in PR reviews with attention to maintainability, accessibility, and code quality

  • Support and mentor junior engineers within the team

  • Stay current with modern frontend technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • 6–9 years of experience in frontend development

  • Strong expertise in React and frontend fundamentals (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)

  • Experience working in product-based organizations

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle

  • Experience debugging frontend applications and optimizing performance

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows

  • Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals

  • Solid TypeScript experience including types, generics, and reusable component patterns

  • Experience with modern frontend tooling and package management

  • Experience building reusable UI components and scalable frontend applications

  • Hands-on experience with Tailwind CSS or modern styling approaches

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with WebRTC or real-time communication technologies.

  • Experience with React Native or mobile application development

  • Exposure to modern state/data management libraries (e.g., TanStack Query)

  • Familiarity with monorepo tooling such as Turborepo, Nx, or pnpm workspaces

  • Familiarity with modern frontend architecture patterns

  • Experience with real-time or WebSocket-based applications

  • Familiarity with Storybook-driven component development

  • Exposure to headless UI/component libraries such as Radix UI or Base UI

  • Flexibility to contribute across web, mobile, or browser extension experiences

AI & Modern Engineering Expectations

  • Leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity through code generation, testing, debugging, and workflow efficiency

  • Understand how AI-powered experiences improve customer engagement and platform usability

  • Stay current with emerging AI-assisted engineering practices and frontend development trends

  • Contribute to building scalable and modern user experiences aligned with Nextiva’s AI-powered Unified-CXM platform vision

Additional Qualities

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work on time

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality

  • Collaborative team player with strong communication skills

  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and embrace new technologies

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

  • Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
  • Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
  • Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. location: São Paulo, State of São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Futurex está buscando personas con talento, con pasión por la tecnología e interés por los negocios, para unirse a nuestro equipo de Arquitectos de Soluciones en el puesto de Arquitecto de Soluciones.

El rol de Arquitecto de Soluciones es un híbrido entre el desarrollo de negocios y el soporte de TI. Los arquitectos de soluciones se sienten tan cómodos trabajando con la tecnología como con las personas. El puesto se centra inicialmente en el desarrollo de un profundo conocimiento de la tecnología de Futurex, participando en nuestro proceso de garantía de calidad del software, progresando en la asistencia al cliente y las ventas con organizaciones de nivel 1 en todo el mundo. Las responsabilidades incluyen:

  • Analizar los requisitos de los clientes y recomendar mejoras para nuestras soluciones criptográficas de vanguardia basadas en hardware
  • Proporcionar apoyo técnico y orientación continuos a la base de clientes global de Futurex
  • Solucionar problemas de hardware, software y firmware nuevos y existentes desarrollados para la industria de la seguridad y el cifrado de datos
  • Impartir formación a los clientes sobre nuestros productos y las mejores prácticas de seguridad de datos
  • Proporcionar servicios de gestión de proyectos para iniciativas de desarrollo personalizadas e implementaciones globales de plataformas de seguridad empresarial reforzadas
  • Redactar y mantener la documentación técnica que se hace pública
  • Comprender las API y los protocolos específicos del sector que se utilizan cuando se interactúa con sistemas externos
  • Aplicar los conocimientos empresariales y la capacidad técnica para crear soluciones de vanguardia que ayuden a las empresas a proteger sus datos sensibles

Futurex is seeking talented individuals with a passion for technology and an interest in business to join our Solutions Architect team in the position of Solutions Architect. The position can be based out of Futurex’s office in either Mexico City, or in Brazil.

The Solutions Architect role is a hybrid between business development and IT support. Solutions Architects are as comfortable working with technology as they are with people. The position focuses initially on developing a deep knowledge of Futurex technology by participating in our software quality assurance process, progressing into customer support and sales with Tier-1 organizations worldwide. Responsibilities include:

  • Analyze customer requirements and recommend enhancements to our cutting-edge, hardware-based cryptographic solutions
  • Provide ongoing technical support and guidance to Futurex’s global customer base
  • Test and troubleshoot new and existing hardware, software, and firmware developed for the data security and encryption industry
  • Conduct customer training on our products and data security best practices
  • Provide project management services for custom development initiatives and global Hardened Enterprise Security Platform implementations
  • Write and maintain technical documentation released to the public
  • Understand industry-specific APIs and protocols used when interfacing with external systems
  • Apply business knowledge and technical ability to create state-of-the-art solutions to help enterprises secure their sensitive data

Requirements

Requisitos

  • Licenciatura en una especialidad técnica y/o empresarial
  • Amplia experiencia en tecnologías de la información
  • Gran capacidad de resolución de problemas
  • Gran capacidad de comunicación
  • Mentalidad motivada y emprendedora
  • Flexibilidad para ayudar en diferentes departamentos de la empresa

Requisitos con mayor preferencia:

  • Familiaridad con la tecnología de cifrado de datos de la empresa, incluidos los módulos de seguridad de hardware (HSM); soluciones de gestión de claves, certificados y PKI de la empresa; y/o tokenización para el cumplimiento de PCI DSS
  • 2-4 años de experiencia en un puesto relacionado con la ciberseguridad
  • Experiencia en redes TCP/IP
  • Experiencia con múltiples arquitecturas y plataformas
  • Experiencia con Linux, OpenSSL, scripts (Python, Perl, Bash)
  • Experiencia en ventas y/o soporte técnico

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in technical and/or business related major
  • Broad information technology background
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Motivated, entrepreneurial mindset
  • Flexibility to assist in several different departments of the company

Preferred

  • Familiarity with enterprise data encryption technology, including hardware security modules (HSM); enterprise key, certificate, and PKI management solutions; and/or tokenization for PCI DSS compliance
  • 2-4 years of experience in a cybersecurity-related position
  • Experience with TCP/IP networking
  • Experience with multiple architectures and platforms
  • Experience with Linux, OpenSSL, scripting (Python, Perl, Bash)
  • Experience with sales and/or technical support

title: Técnico Eletromecânico II
description:
A Adeste, referência no mercado de alimentos, saúde e nutrição animal, busca um Técnico Eletromecânico II para fazer parte da equipe! O que esperamos de você?


🎯 Buscamos profissionais com garra e atitude de dono, comprometidos em alcançar resultados extraordinários.

Quais serão as responsabilidades e desafios? 📝


  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em instalações elétricas industriais e prediais;
  • Atuar em redes de média e baixa tensão, incluindo a manutenção e operação de cabines primárias e secundárias, transformadores de energia, troca de cruzetas, para-raios poliméricos e demais componentes da rede;
  • Realizar a instalação, parametrização e manutenção de inversores de frequência e soft starters;
  • Interpretar e elaborar diagramas elétricos de força e comando, assegurando a execução correta e segura dos serviços;
  • Executar intervenções elétricas em sistemas de automação industrial, com conhecimento em CLPs (Controladores Lógicos Programáveis) para diagnóstico e suporte técnico em painéis automatizados;
  • Realizar retrofit de máquinas e equipamentos, visando a adequação às exigências da NR-10 (Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade);
  • Montar novos painéis elétricos de força e comando conforme demandas operacionais e projetos de engenharia;
  • Executar reparos e instalações em disjuntores, transformadores, motores, chaves de distribuição, balanças e demais equipamentos elétricos;
  • Instalar e manter sistemas de iluminação, comandos, tomadas, interruptores, quadros de distribuição e cabeamentos (elétrico, telefônico e de rede de dados);
  • Montar, desmontar e adaptar painéis elétricos conforme alterações em processos produtivos ou layouts;
  • Verificar e executar manutenção corretiva em equipamentos de ar-condicionado (parte elétrica);
  • Testar, organizar e acondicionar adequadamente os equipamentos e materiais utilizados após manutenção;
  • Reportar falhas, anomalias, riscos operacionais e condições inseguras ao superior imediato;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme demanda da liderança.
  • Realizar inspeções de rotina para avaliar o estado de conservação e funcionamento de equipamentos mecânicos.
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em máquinas, motores, bombas, redes hidráulicas e demais sistemas industriais.
  • Confeccionar, fabricar, montar e instalar componentes, máquinas e equipamentos mecânicos, hidráulicos e pneumáticos, incluindo ampliações de instalações, conforme as necessidades da planta.
  • Operar processos de usinagem com torno e fraseadora convencional , soldagem (MIG, MAG, eletrodo revestido, oxiacetilênica), corte (quente e frio), caldeiraria, ajustagem e pintura em madeira, alvenaria e estruturas metálicas.
  • Realizar manutenções hidráulicas em sistemas de água, vapor e ar comprimido, bem como manutenção pneumática em compressores, incluindo troca de óleo e limpeza de filtros.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e montagem de novos projetos e equipamentos.
  • Sugerir melhorias em máquinas e processos para aumentar a eficiência, segurança e reduzir o tempo de manutenção.
  • Manter a organização da oficina e do depósito de materiais.
  • Reportar ao superior imediato quaisquer anomalias em ferramentas, equipamentos ou condições inseguras.
  • Seguir e promover o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho, qualidade e Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF).

O que iremos avaliar?🔎


  • curso Técnico Completo em Eletrotécnica/ Eletromecânica ou Automação Industrial.
  • Conhecimento em eletroeletrônica ou automação industrial, solda industrial e painéis elétricos

Onde você irá trabalhar?


📍 Temos 8 localidades, mas esta posição terá como base o site de Botucatu.


Valorizamos as diferenças e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Todas as nossas vagas (respeitam esse compromisso e) se estendem a pessoas com deficiência (PcD).


Se identificou? Se inscreva! Queremos te conhecer!

title: Farm Crew Team
description:
Farm Crew Member – Old South Carriage Company

Are you passionate about horses and looking for a hands-on role in a dynamic, team-oriented environment? Old South Carriage Company is seeking dedicated individuals to join our Farm Crew! As part of our team, you'll play a key role in operations by maintaining the health and well-being of our draft horses and additionally transporting them between our scenic 110 acre Farm on Johns Island and the historic stables in downtown Charleston.

What You’ll Do:

  • Safely transport horses between our 110-acre farm on Johns Island and our downtown Charleston stables.
  • Maintain and manage our three barns, ensuring a clean and organized environment.
  • Feed, water, and care for our herd, including administering basic healthcare and medications.
  • Groom horses, clean stalls, and prepare draft horses for tours.
  • Assist with daily farm operations, facility maintenance, and small projects.
  • Ensure the overall well-being of our herd while upholding our company’s commitment to excellence.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For:

  • Confidence and experience in caring for draft horses
  • Experience in driving a truck and trailer and the ability to transport horses safely.
  • A team-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently.
  • Open availability (7 days a week, between 6 AM – 10 PM).
  • A valid driver’s license with clean driving record.
  • A professional and hospitable attitude

Benefits

  • Competitive Pay: Starting at $18–$20 per hour, based on experience and role.
  • Full-Time Schedule: 5 shifts per week, with AM and PM shifts available.
  • Growth & Learning Opportunities: Continuing education and career advancement within the company.
  • A Unique Work Environment: Spend time on our scenic Johns Island farm and in the heart of historic Charleston.

If you’re ready to work with a team that values hospitality, horsemanship, and hard work, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Broista – Mauldin, SC
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros, we’re all about embracing the grind with every crew member, shop, and customer interaction–all while making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real—this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, requires high-energy, and is physically demanding. You’ll be moving quickly and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering unforgettable service.

We sell coffee, but we’re in the relationship business creating genuine connections every chance we get!

Who You Are:

  • People person. Thrives on connection and loves making someone’s day.
  • Adaptable and quick. Can handle a rush and keep the positivity flowing.
  • Team-oriented. Ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.
  • Committed to a growth mindset. Because greatness doesn’t come easy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Positivity. Make genuine connections, and ensure every visit is memorable.
  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values—radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.
  • Make an Impact. Serve the community and learn the art of giving to others.
  • Be Reliable. Show up on time, support your crew, and be ready to roll when your shift starts.

What to Expect:

  • Fast-paced, high-energy work. You’ll be moving quickly and handling a steady flow of customers for up to 10-hour shifts—so take those breaks to recharge!
  • Crew-first mentality. We support each other, have everyone’s back, and get the job done—together.
  • Weather-ready. Be prepared for all conditions rain or shine—we’ve got Dutch gear to help!
  • Some heavy lifting. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs (talk about a workout!).
  • Reliability. You’ll need to show up on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.
  • Training & Development. We’ll set you up for success with hands-on training and menu knowledge tests to make sure you meet Dutch Bros standards.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • We’ve got your back. Competitive pay, tips, and opportunities for career growth within the shop, headquarters (HQ), and or warehouse & roasting facilities.
  • Perks on perks. Tuition reimbursement, free drinks, Dutch Bros swag, and an uplifting work environment like no other!
  • Make a difference. Every cup you serve fuels our community—powering local givebacks and our biggest philanthropy days.
  • Shop Perks. Work surrounded by upbeat music, a casual dress code, and a roster of friendly faces.

If you're ready to make a massive difference, we're stoked to talk to you! Dutch Bros isn't just a J-O-B, it's an opportunity to learn, grow, and have fun TOGETHER!

Compensation:

Up to $15.65 per hour

Number includes an average tip of $5.65 per hour. What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2025 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
KDA Consulting Inc. is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to support mission-critical programs within the Intelligence Community (IC). This role focuses on designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and automated deployment solutions to enable efficient, secure, and scalable software delivery.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with containerization, orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms, along with a strong foundation in automation and system reliability.

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and continuous delivery of applications
  • Automate build, test, and deployment processes to improve development efficiency and reduce manual intervention
  • Integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DevSecOps pipelines

Containerization & Orchestration

  • Develop and manage containerized applications using Docker
  • Deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms
  • Optimize container performance, resource utilization, and scalability

Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Work within cloud environments such as AWS or Azure to deploy and manage infrastructure
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Support system modernization efforts by transitioning legacy systems to cloud-native architectures

Monitoring, Logging & System Reliability

  • Implement monitoring and alerting solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch
  • Proactively identify and resolve system performance issues and bottlenecks
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and fault tolerance of deployed systems

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

  • Work closely with software developers, system engineers, and security teams to streamline development and deployment processes
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Provide technical guidance on DevOps best practices and automation strategies

Requirements

Active TS/SCI W/ Polygraph Required.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Demonstrated experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline development, and automation

Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes

Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar)

Strong scripting skills in languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell

Experience with version control systems such as Git

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

To ensure proper maintenance and distribution of disposable supplies and durable medical equipment for patient care.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience as a sterile processing technician within the last 12 months; or graduate of an accredited Sterile Processing Technician program (such as HSPA, CBSPD, CAAHEP, etc.) within the last 12 months.

    Documents results of biologic and vacuum testing
    Documents actions in the event of load recall
    Labels all implantables for quick identification for quarantine
    Assures accurate labeling of instruments/sets.
    Evaluation Method(s):
    Demonstration, Documentation Review, Quality Monitoring.

    Disassembles multipart instruments
    Separates heavy and delicate instruments
    Properly cares for powered, lensed and special instruments/ equipment
    Inspects instruments/instrument trays for broken, damaged or missing instruments
    Reassembles trays, protecting sharp/delicate/heavy instruments, checks for cleanliness
    Labels trays according to type, includes count sheets with trays
    Properly loads and operates washer sterilizer, sonic cleaners, steam, plasma, parasitic acid and other sterilizing equipment'

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Nitorilla autamme asiakkaitamme rakentamaan tekoälykyvykkyyttä - emme vain toimita ratkaisuja, vaan muutamme tapaa, jolla tiimit ajattelevat ja työskentelevät tekoälyn kanssa. AI Engineerina pääset rakentamaan tekoälyratkaisuja asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaympäristöihin ja samalla vaikuttamaan AI-kehityksen suuntaan Nitorilla.


🤖 Lyhyesti roolistasi Senior AI Engineerinä

AI Engineerina Nitorilla viet tekoälyä ideasta tuotantoon - ei demoihin, vaan ratkaisuihin, jotka pyörivät liiketoimintaympäristöissä ja tuottavat vaikutusta asiakkaillemme.

Työskentelet tiiviisti asiakkaiden kanssa: kuuntelet, keskustelet liiketoimintatarpeista ja rakennat AI-ratkaisuja, jotka toimivat tuotannossa. Osallistut arkkitehtuuripäätöksiin, tuot LLMOps- ja EvalOps-käytäntöjä tiimiin ja autat asiakkaita kehittämään omaa tekoälykyvykkyyttään.

Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa hyvin erilaisia projekteja esimerkiksi tekoälypohjaisesta asiakaspalveluautomaatiosta yrityksen prosesseihin integroituihin agentteihin ja LLM-pohjaisiin järjestelmiin, jotka muuttavat kokonaisten tiimien toimintaa. Omistat ratkaisun alusta loppuun.

Lisäksi pääset mukaan muovaamaan, miten AI Engineerin työtä Nitorilla tehdään - tämä on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa käytäntöihin, joita ollaan vasta luomassa.

✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?

Loistat tässä roolissa, jos sinulla on:

  • Vahva osaaminen useammasta ohjelmointikielestä (kuten TypeScript, Python, Kotlin, Java) sekä kokemusta tuotantotason AI/ML-järjestelmien rakentamisesta
  • Kokemusta LLM-rajapintojen käytöstä (OpenAI, Anthropic tai vastaavat)
  • Kokemusta agenttiframeworkeista kuten LangChainin Deep Agents, OpenAI Agents SDK tai Claude Agent SDK
  • Tuntemus tekoälyalustoista kuten Microsoft AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock tai Google Vertex AI
  • Ymmärrys LLMOps-käytännöistä ja mallien elinkaarenhallinnasta
  • Kokemus observability-työkaluista kuten LangSmith on plussaa
  • Käytännön kokemus vähintään yhdestä pilvipalvelusta: AWS, Azure tai Google Cloud
  • Vahvat Docker- ja kontittamistaidot
  • Kokemus CI/CD-putkista (esim. GitHub Actions)
  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito on tärkeää, sillä asiakkaita on sekä kotimaassa että kansainvälisesti.

🏆 Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.

Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos:

  • haluat rakentaa tekoälyä, joka toimii tuotannossa - oikeissa asiakasympäristöissä ja oikeissa liiketoimintaprosesseissa
  • innostut käytäntöjen muovaamisesta, joita ei vielä ole - AI engineering on vasta muotoutumassa, ja Nitorilla pääset tähän vaikuttamaan
  • pidät merkityksellisenä jättää jotain pysyvää jälkeesi: asiakastiimejä, jotka ajattelevat ja rakentavat tekoälyn kanssa eri tavalla
  • viihdyt vaihtelevissa projekteissa - eri toimialat ja eri stackit
  • rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ovat sinulle tärkeitä
  • koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja kollegoille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja
  • sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa

Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet, esimerkiksi:

  • Voit käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen
  • 7100 € "Rautapankki" työväline- ja kotitoimistohankintoihin, joka täydentyy kuukausittain
  • Täydet palkalliset lomat heti työsuhteen alusta riippumatta aloitusajankohdasta
  • 500-2000 € bonus jokaisesta suorittamastasi sertifikaatista
  • Yhteisiä matkoja, tapahtumia ja harrastusryhmiä aina juoksuklubista lautapelikerhoon

❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Olisimme todella kiinnostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa. Lähetä meille LinkedIn-profiilisi tai CV:si. Lisätietoja voit kysyä People Partneriltamme Ella Raskilalta (ella.raskila@nitor.com). Haluamme varmistaa, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.

👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Haluamme tarjota asiantuntijoillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

AI engineering kehittyy nopeasti - ja niin teemme mekin. Olet osa tiiviistä insinöörien ja konsulttien yhteisöä, joka on aidosti utelias siitä, mihin tuotannossa käytettävä tekoäly on menossa, ja rehellinen siitä, että kenelläkään ei ole vielä kaikkia vastauksia. Et joudu selvittämään asioita yksin: sinulla on kollegoita, joiden kanssa ajatella ääneen, jakaa löydöksiä ja haastaa omia oletuksia. Mielenkiintoiset koulutukset, tapahtumat ja konferenssit pitävät sinut kehityksen etulinjassa, ja voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, AI engineering -käytäntöjen kehittämiseen.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty - päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Toimintatapamme perustuvat luottamukseen, avoimuuteen ja toistemme kunnioittamiseen. Jokainen nitorilainen tuo oman lisänsä yrityksen toimintaan. Arvostamme ja vaalimme erilaisuutta sekä sen tuomaa lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme.

🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on digitaalinen insinööri; pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä ja Tampereella, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi. Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

title: Senior Counsel, Media Transactions (Remote)
description:
Are you a seasoned media attorney ready to make an impact across one of America's leading media companies? The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Sr. Counsel, Media Transactions to support our dynamic media, production, distribution, and content businesses. In this role, you'll provide strategic legal guidance on commercial transactions, original production activities, content licensing, distribution matters, and operational issues—all while partnering closely with business leaders to drive results and manage risk.

This is a remote position offering the flexibility to work from your home office while collaborating with talented colleagues across the company.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Serve as a generalist media/entertainment attorney supporting matters involving distribution, programming, production, licensing, advertising, marketing, operations, and corporate initiatives.

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on commercial agreements, including content licensing, production, services, vendor, nondisclosure, release, and other media-related contracts.

  • Support original production and content-rights work, including development, production, clearance, rights, releases, production services, location matters, risk management, acquisition, use, distribution, renewal, sublicensing, exclusivity, windowing, territory, term, and rights-clearance issues.

  • Support distribution-related legal work, including carriage, affiliation, retransmission, platform, and digital distribution arrangements, as needed.

  • Oversee and manage litigation and disputes, including outside counsel strategy, budgets, pleadings and correspondence, discovery, settlement evaluation, pre-litigation disputes, demand letters, claims, subpoenas, investigations, and stakeholder communications.

  • Provide practical advice on negotiation strategy, risk mitigation, contract interpretation, compliance obligations, operational questions, and dispute avoidance; maintain templates, playbooks, approval processes, and best practices; support responsible AI and technology-enabled legal department improvements; monitor relevant legal and industry developments; and support special projects as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in good standing with at least one state bar; OH, NY, or GA preferred

  • Generally, 10+ years experience working in a media and/or television environment with content exploited through linear and non-linear means, including broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms preferred

  • Significant experience practicing law in a law firm, corporate legal department, media company, entertainment company, or comparable business environment, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating media/entertainment-focused agreements preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Practical legal judgment and risk assessment

  • Strong business partnership and client service orientation

  • Contract drafting and negotiation skills

  • Litigation management and dispute resolution

  • Media, production, licensing, and distribution fluency; clear communication and executive presence

  • Project management and prioritization skills

  • Technology fluency, including openness to artificial intelligence and other tools to support efficient, high-quality legal services; and a collaborative, collegial, team-oriented approach

#LI-SM2
#LI-Remote

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

title: Emergency Room Associate FT Days
description:
Your job is more than a job

Let’s face it, no patient wants to be in an emergency room. Car accident injuries, chest pains, breathing difficulties, strokes, burns, heart attacks and broken bones, being part of an ER care team takes emotional strength and a positive attitude. As an Emergency Room Technician, you understand the power of teamwork as you work alongside nurses, doctors and other healthcare professionals responding to urgent medical situations.

While you don’t know your patients personally, you take each emergency personally because your empathy and compassion for suffering is boundless. That’s what we love about you.

Your experiences, your knowledge, your skills, your empathy, your compassion, your personality, all of it adds up to you. And we’re excited to get to know you and find out what you’ll bring to this supportive emergency room technician role.


Your Everyday

Obtains patient’s vital signs as directed.

Communicate with patient’s nurse practitioner to report any out-of-range vital signs or patient/parental concerns

Assists with specimen collection such as midstream, urine/clean, catch urine specimen, nasal swab, etc.

After delineation, provides surface trauma or orthopedic care support per physician order or delegation of medical/nursing personnel.

Check on patients both in patient’s rooms and emergency department waiting areas and escort them to treatment/testing areas.

Answer unit telephone, call lights and alarms promptly to determine needs.

Maintain clean room, unit and unit equipment as well as other unit areas refreshing supplies, linens, and disinfecting room according to policy.

Assist in emergency situations as requested.

The Must-Haves

Minimum:

High School Diploma or 2 years of experience in related clinical area.

American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

Crisis Prevention Institute Non-violent Crisis Prevention certification.

WORK SHIFT:

Days (United States of America)

LCMC Health is a community.

Our people make health happen. While our NOLA roots run deep, our branches are the vessels that carry our mission of bringing the best possible care to every person and parish in Louisiana and beyond and put a little more heart and soul into healthcare along the way. Celebrating authenticity, originality, equity, inclusion and a little “come on in” attitude is the foundation of LCMC Health’s culture of everyday extraordinary

Your extras

  • Deliver healthcare with heart.
  • Give people a reason to smile.
  • Put a little love in your work.
  • Be honest and real, but with compassion.
  • Bring some lagniappe into everything you do.

title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer (Android)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own Android architecture decisions, ship polished Kotlin applications, and set the standard for how AI accelerates engineering at Xsolla.
Deep expertise in modern Android is essential: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, and the Jetpack library surface, along with a proven track record of shipping commercial applications to Google Play from concept to launch. The ability to design scalable architectures, implement robust testing strategies, profile and optimize startup time, jank, memory, and battery across a fragmented device landscape, and mentor other engineers while collaborating across cross-functional teams will be key to your success in this role.
We build AI-first. We expect you to work fluently with AI coding agents as a daily multiplier - scoping work for them, reviewing what they produce with a critical eye, and building the internal tooling, context, and evaluation habits that make the whole team faster.
If you’re passionate about building high-quality Android experiences that scale, and love shipping apps that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain our native Android application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, used by players and developers worldwide.
  • Deliver high-quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration.
  • Own the full Android release process: signing, App Bundles, Play Console tracks, staged rollouts, pre-launch reports, and crash and ANR triage.
  • Implement best practices for Android development, including code review, automated testing strategies, and CI/CD with Gradle, Fastlane, or equivalent.
  • Integrate mini-apps, payments, and virtual currency systems into the Xsolla App ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to turn business goals into experiences that feel genuinely native.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, QA engineers, and project managers, and communicate effectively across distributed, multi-timezone teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

Architecture & Design

  • Design and implement scalable application architecture for Android with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Lead architectural decisions around modularization, dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger), navigation, and state management (MVVM, MVI, unidirectional data flow).
  • Configure and optimize the Gradle build, convention plugins, version catalogs, build caching, and configuration cache, for fast, incremental builds.
  • Build and maintain an internal Compose component library and design system implementation.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.
  • Partner with the iOS and React Native engineers to keep shared API contracts, design tokens, feature flags, and analytics schemas coherent across the app family, without flattening the platform into a lowest common denominator.
  • Drive observability for mobile: structured logging, crash monitoring, performance tracing, and release health dashboards.

AI-First Engineering

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants as a core part of your daily workflow, and raise the bar for how the team prompts, reviews, and verifies AI-generated code.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes agents effective in our codebase: project rules, tool integrations, reproducible dev environments, and automated checks that catch what review misses.
  • Design evaluation and guardrails for AI features, including prompt regression testing, fallback behavior, and handling of model failure modes in production.
  • Share what works: mentor engineers on AI-assisted development and help set practical, quality-preserving standards for the organization.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional Android development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Kotlin.
  • Proven track record of shipping commercial Android applications, with apps you built currently live on Google Play.
  • Strong command of modern Android frameworks and idioms: Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, Lifecycle, Room, WorkManager, and Navigation.
  • Strong understanding of Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture), dependency injection, and state management.
  • Experience with automated testing on Android: JUnit, Compose UI tests, Espresso, Robolectric, and with CI/CD for Android release pipelines.
  • Solid grasp of performance, memory, and battery profiling using Android Studio Profiler, Macrobenchmark, and Baseline Profiles.
  • Experience building for a fragmented device and OS-version landscape, including large-screen and foldable form factors.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven, daily use of AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate real production work - scoping tasks for agents, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and measurably increasing your own and your team’s velocity.
  • Experience with third-party integrations, REST/GraphQL APIs, and mobile SDK consumption.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a results-driven approach.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app widgets, deep linking, push notifications (FCM), or background work at scale.
  • Experience bridging Kotlin modules into React Native, or with Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Familiarity with Google Play Billing and alternative billing / external offer programs.
  • Familiarity with gaming ecosystems, virtual currency platforms, in-app purchases, or alternative payment and digital commerce flows.
  • Experience with mobile security practices: secure storage, certificate pinning, obfuscation, and fraud prevention.
  • Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks in the mobile or AI engineering space.
Benefits:
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

title: Commercial Banking Representative II
description:
**If you are a current FIB employee, please apply through the Career Worklet in the Employee Portal.

This position is located at our Hamburg, IA branch.

What’s Important to You
We know your career is just one aspect of a meaningful, complex, and demanding life. That’s why we designed our compensation and benefits package to provide employees and their families with as much choice as possible.

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) in addition to paid federal holidays.
  • Child Care Assistance Program for eligible dependent(s).
  • Exercise reimbursement program for employees.
  • The health and happiness of the places we call home matter to us. Learn a little more about what we do for the communities we serve and why we want YOU to be a part of it.

We encourage you to apply. Reach for what you want and tell us why your work ethic and willingness to learn make you a natural fit for #TeamFirstInterstate.

SUMMARY
The Commercial Banking Representative II functions as a primary contact between commercial banking clients and the Bank, and assists Commercial Relationship Managers with servicing the client, for all loan types including large and complex loan portfolios. Responsible for maintaining and expanding the relationship with clients by providing overall client support services. Works proactively to maximize client satisfaction and encourage expansion of the relationship. Develops working knowledge of assigned area and accounts through frequent client contact and execution of standard procedures. Essential duties are performed individually with limited supervision required.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Handles day-to-day client calls, client transactions, and client problem resolution. Responds to client account inquiries, performs account maintenance and researches/resolves client problems.
  • Executes client transactions within delegated authority or applicable department guidelines, escalating to the assigned Relationship Manager (RM) any requests outside specified norms or items requiring Relationship Manager signature or approval. Transactions may include transfers, withdrawals, distributions, wire transfers, payments, fee waivers/fee refunds, client overdrafts, monitoring reports, and other loan and account operations requested by clients.
  • Assists in obtaining necessary information to submit loan applications, such as financial statements, tax returns and business documentation. May also work with outside vendors, such as attorneys or title companies, UCC searches, title work, OFAC Environmental Reports, appraisals, and flood determinations. May work with outside counsel, title companies, other product vendors, etc. to request documents needed for loan requests, when applicable.
  • Specializes in loan documentation and ensures accuracy in loan documents and legal loan file. To include reviewing documents, organizing legal loan documents, and supporting information, and accuracy in digital records.
  • Prepares and/or reviews client account documents for meetings between the RM and the client, focusing on completion of signatures, accuracy, and fulfillment of standard regulatory and compliance guidelines.
  • Submits complete and accurate requests for documentation in accordance with the loan approval, ensuring all appropriate supporting documents are available in Director/Unity Client, including but not limited to loan approval, Borrower, Guarantor, and Grantor entity documents, collateral reports, and all other information necessary to generate loan documents.
  • Provides complete packages to Loan Servicing for Boarding/Funding, ensuring appropriate GLs are credited for fees collected.
  • Ensures all documentation is uploaded to Director/Unity Client timely, imaged files are complete.
  • Creates ticklers in Credit Track in accordance with the loan agreement & guaranty requirements and assists Relationship Manager with obtaining required information to clear ticklers.
  • Supports commercial relationship managers and group managers with review and certification of; legal entity validation (dba, partnership, S-Corp, C-Corp, LLC, and trusts), real estate collateral documentation (title commitment, environmental reports, hazard insurance, and appraisals), UCC and titled collateral validation.
  • Supports commercial relationship managers and group managers with treasury and deposit products in partnership with internal bank Treasury, Retail Banking teams and other business line referral programs including payment and wealth products.
  • Actively ensures compliance with the Code of Ethics and all Anti-Money Laundering, Bank Secrecy Act, information security and suspicious activity reporting requirements, policies and procedures. Actively participates in any required corporate and business line training in these areas. Understands and follows internal suspicious activity referral requirements and processes, as required for this position. Actively works with clients to understand each client’s normal account activity, as appropriate for this position.
  • Maintains working knowledge of all regulatory, legal, and Credit Policy requirements to ensure all applications, documentation and loan accounts are compliant.
  • Participates in internal and external training to maintain knowledge of Bank products; attends operational and exception meetings and keep abreast of all credit policies and changes.
  • Maintains positive working relationship with peers and other business unit team members.
  • Generates or obtains daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports as assigned. Reviews reports for accuracy and compliance and takes action to update systems or make other corrections.
  • May reconcile client accounts, enter client financial data into databases, and monitor exceptions to company policies.
  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of key software systems and other Loan Operating Systems.


QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Advanced understanding of credit products, bank systems and commercial lending.
  • Exhibits a sophisticated understanding of applicable federal regulations, credit policy and bank policies and procedures.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills including oral and written communication.
  • Problem solving skills.
  • Proficiency with personal computers and related software packages.


EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
  • 4-6 years banking experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience required


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT
The physical demands and work environment are representative of those that must be met or encountered to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the company provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

  • Dexterity of hands/fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse - Frequently
  • Sitting - Frequently
  • Standing - Occasionally
  • Overtime - Subject to business need
  • Noise Level - Moderate
  • Typical Work Hours - M-F (8-5)
  • Regular and Predictable Attendance - Required
