title: Data Architect (Mid-Level)
description:
Data Architect – Insights (AI/ML)

Location: Remote (US)
Department: Insights (AI/ML)
Reports to: Engineering Manager

About the Role

Irth is building a new AI-driven threat and risk management platform for pipeline asset integrity. The platform brings together three capabilities that have historically been separate at Irth:

  • A governed, cross-product data platform built on Databricks and Azure
  • An AI-powered ingestion layer that normalizes, repairs, and enriches customer data without services-heavy onboarding
  • A reusable analytical layer that runs industry-standard, Irth-developed, and customer-built risk models against the data

We are seeking a mid-level Data Architect to design the schema and data model that powers this platform. You will create a unified structure spanning asset integrity, damage prevention, and land and stakeholder management, capable of supporting probabilistic risk models that require dozens of precisely defined input attributes per pipeline segment.

This is a hands-on design role. You will establish standards for data lineage, governance, and quality while working closely with the data engineering team to implement them. This role is ideal for someone with substantial experience in lakehouse and medallion architecture who is ready to own the data model for a platform rather than a single project.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Design the schema and unified data model for the platform, spanning asset, inspection, incident, geospatial, and consequence data across multiple products.
  • Apply medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and define the semantic layer consumed by downstream models, reporting, and applications.
  • Model the data required by probabilistic risk models, ensuring every required input attribute has a defined source, transformation path, and data-quality expectation.
  • Design cross-product entity resolution so records from separate products reconcile to shared assets and entities.
  • Define ingestion patterns for batch, streaming, and change-data-capture (CDC) sources, including schema evolution and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Produce architecture documentation, diagrams, data dictionaries, and decision records that engineers can implement without ambiguity.

2. Geospatial & Domain Data Design

  • Design the shared GIS layer as a first-class component of the data model, including pipeline centerlines, consequence-area polygons, right-of-way corridors, and parcel data.
  • Model linear referencing and dynamic segmentation so risk results align with centerline geometry and can be aggregated across differing segmentations.
  • Define data structures for inspection data, repair history, and external enrichment sources such as weather history, soil characteristics, and satellite-derived data.

3. Governance, Lineage & Data Quality

  • Define cataloging, classification, and metadata standards in Unity Catalog and establish expectations for lineage coverage across the data estate.
  • Establish data-quality rules, validation gates, and profiling standards, including processes for quarantining and remediating failures.
  • Define access-control patterns, including role-based and attribute-based access, tenant isolation, and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
  • Design for end-to-end traceability so that any risk output can be traced through every transformation back to its source record.

4. Implementation Partnership

  • Work directly with data engineers to translate architectural designs into production pipelines and review implementations for conformance.
  • Contribute hands-on to schema deployment, transformation logic, and optimization when it accelerates delivery.
  • Partner with application engineers and data scientists to determine how the data model is consumed through serving layers, feature stores, and APIs.
  • Support performance and cost optimization, including partitioning, clustering, file layout, and compute sizing.

5. Collaboration & Documentation

  • Participate in design reviews and architecture alignment sessions and defend design decisions using data and evidence.
  • Work with subject-matter experts to translate domain and regulatory requirements into concrete data structures and standards.
  • Maintain architecture documentation as the model evolves, treating stale or inaccurate documentation as a defect.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, or senior data engineering, including end-to-end ownership of a non-trivial data model.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, SQL Warehouses, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Strong command of medallion and lakehouse architecture patterns, dimensional modeling, and semantic layer design.
  • Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python or PySpark.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform; Azure experience preferred.
  • Practical experience with change data capture (CDC), slowly changing dimensions (SCD), schema evolution, and data-quality frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, including cataloging, lineage, classification, role-based access control (RBAC), and encryption.
  • Strong documentation and diagramming skills, with the ability to explain data models clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing geospatial data models and working with GIS tooling, spatial joins, and linear referencing.
  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, data residency requirements, or regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with metadata and lineage tools such as Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience modeling data specifically for machine learning or probabilistic risk models.
  • Experience designing semantic layers for business intelligence (BI) consumption.
  • Databricks or cloud data certifications.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot and/or agentic coding tools such as Claude Code as part of a professional development workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with pipeline or utility asset data, including inline inspection results, alignment sheets, facilities, and centerline geometry.
  • Understanding of asset integrity concepts such as corrosion growth, defect tracking, and consequence-of-failure modeling.
  • Awareness of regulatory reporting requirements applicable to pipeline integrity data.
  • Experience migrating data from legacy desktop or spreadsheet-based systems.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • A documented and implemented data model that supports every required risk-model input attribute with a clearly defined source and transformation path.
  • High lineage coverage and demonstrable traceability from risk outputs back to the originating source records.
  • Data engineers consistently able to build from the architecture and documentation without repeated clarification.
  • Reliable cross-product entity resolution across shared assets and entities.

The Operational Excellence Business Partner provides direct support for OPEX projects in support of the site agenda. This role reports to the Operational Excellence Lead. The Business Partner is an SME in Lean, Problem Solving, Root Cause Analysis, Manufacturing Standards of Operational Excellence, and Human Performance Reliability.   • Participate in Flow Team governance, identify trends, and lead improvement initiatives

  • Serve as Operational Excellence Business Partner by partnering with Business Area Leaders to facilitate the chosen methodology for the given project (for example, Kaizen Event)

  • Provide support to ensure robust Organizational Change Management and Monitoring Plans are in place to sustain improvements

Senior Full Stack Engineer – Client Solutions

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who combines strong technical skills with excellent English communication and client-facing confidence.

This role is ideal for someone who can independently manage the complete project lifecycle, work directly with international clients, participate confidently in technical interviews and discovery calls, and support our sales team in converting opportunities into successful projects.

The engineer should also be highly proficient with modern AI development tools and use them as part of their daily engineering workflow to improve development speed, code quality, debugging, research, testing, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle software projects from requirements and technical planning to development, deployment, and ongoing support.
  • Develop scalable full-stack web applications using modern technologies.
  • Participate in client interviews, discovery calls, technical discussions, and project kickoffs.
  • Support the sales team in understanding requirements, evaluating technical feasibility, estimating effort, and proposing solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly and confidently to international clients.
  • Prepare technical approaches, architecture, estimates, and implementation plans.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions and project delivery.
  • Review code and maintain engineering quality and security standards.
  • Work effectively with project managers, developers, QA, designers, and DevOps.
  • Quickly understand existing applications and unfamiliar codebases.

AI-Enabled Development

The candidate should be fully comfortable using AI as part of their daily software development workflow.

They should:

  • Regularly use modern AI coding assistants and development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools.
  • Use AI effectively for coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, code reviews, research, and understanding existing codebases.
  • Be comfortable working with agentic development workflows where appropriate.
  • Know how to provide appropriate context and instructions to AI tools to produce reliable results.
  • Critically review, test, and validate AI-generated code rather than accepting output without verification.
  • Understand the security, privacy, and confidentiality considerations involved when using AI tools with company or client code and data.
  • Remain accountable for the quality and correctness of all AI-assisted work.

Technical Requirements

Strong professional experience in at least two of the following:

  • Ruby / Ruby on Rails
  • Python and its web frameworks
  • MERN: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js

Additionally, the candidate should have good experience with:

  • React and modern frontend development
  • REST APIs and third-party integrations
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL and/or MongoDB
  • Git and GitHub
  • AWS or similar cloud platforms
  • CI/CD and application deployment
  • Authentication and application security
  • Performance optimization and debugging

Communication & Client Skills

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Confident communicating directly with international clients.
  • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Comfortable participating in and leading technical interviews.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ability to ask the right questions during discovery instead of simply following provided requirements.
  • Capable of explaining technical decisions, estimates, risks, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is more than just a strong developer.

The ideal candidate can understand the client's problem, communicate confidently, propose the right technical solution, help us win the opportunity, and then take ownership of delivering it successfully.

They should be technically strong, AI-enabled in their daily workflow, adaptable across technologies, and comfortable taking responsibility for both technical delivery and client communication.

title: NP or PA - Pulmonology - Fredericksburg, VA
description:
Start the day excited to make a difference…end the day knowing you did. Come join our team.

Base Salary Range:

1.00 FTE Base Salary: Minimum of $121,908.80 to Maximum of $152,380.80 prorated for FTE

The Inpatient Advanced Practice Provider (APP) for the Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine provides comprehensive clinical services to hospitalized adult and geriatric patients with pulmonary and related cardiopulmonary conditions on the medical and surgical floors at Mary Washington Hospital and Stafford Hospital. The APP functions as an integral member of the inpatient pulmonary care team and practices in collaboration with the attending Pulmonologist under a formal practice agreement, in accordance with Commonwealth of Virginia regulations governing Nurse Practitioners and Physician Assistants. Daily co-rounding, joint patient staffing, and physician-led patient evaluation are core elements of the care model. Clinical decisions are reached collaboratively, with shared responsibility for the inpatient pulmonary plan of care between the APP and the collaborating physician. The APP also works closely with hospitalists, intensivists, nursing, respiratory therapy, and other allied health professionals.
Two (2) APP positions share continuous inpatient pulmonary coverage in an alternating 1-week-on / 1-week-off model. The standard on-week consists of seven (7) consecutive days of clinical coverage with daily shift duration of approximately 10 to 12 hours. APPs may rotate between Mary Washington Hospital and Stafford Hospital based on operational and patient care needs of the service line. Schedule, shift length, days of coverage, site assignment, and clinical assignments are subject to modification at the discretion of the Medical Director of Pulmonology to meet patient care needs and the operational requirements of the service line.
The APP is responsible for the assessment, diagnosis, and management of acute and chronic pulmonary conditions, participation in daily rounds, coordination of care, facilitation of discharges, and provision of patient and family education. The role includes ordering and interpreting diagnostic studies, prescribing pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic therapies, and performing approved pulmonary procedures, including chest tube management, intrapleural fibrinolytic administration, indwelling pleural catheter management, and ultrasound-guided thoracentesis.
The APP practices clinically under a formal practice agreement with the collaborating Pulmonologist(s) and operationally under the Vice President of Nursing Services or designee, in accordance with Commonwealth of Virginia regulations.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Clinical Care

  • Perform comprehensive inpatient evaluations, including history and physical examinations, for patients admitted with pulmonary diagnoses such as COPD, asthma exacerbations, pneumonia, pulmonary embolism, interstitial lung disease, respiratory failure, pleural disease (parapneumonic effusion, empyema, malignant effusion, hemothorax), bronchiectasis, hemoptysis, and tracheostomy-dependent patients on the floor.

  • Staff all inpatient pulmonary consult and follow-up patients daily with the collaborating Pulmonologist, including face-to-face rounding, case discussion, and joint development of the daily clinical plan.

  • Manage an expected daily inpatient consult and rounding census of approximately 10 to 20 patients, with workload distribution adjusted based on acuity, site coverage, and service line demand.

  • Participate in daily interdisciplinary rounds and manage ongoing inpatient pulmonary care jointly with the collaborating pulmonologist of the week.

  • Develop and implement evidence-based diagnostic and treatment plans, including ventilatory support recommendations, oxygen therapy, NIV (CPAP/BiPAP) and high-flow nasal cannula titration, and pulmonary hygiene strategies.

  • Order, review, and interpret diagnostic studies including laboratory tests, arterial blood gases, pulmonary imaging (CXR, CT chest, CT-PA), pleural fluid analysis, and non-invasive cardiopulmonary studies.

  • Prescribe pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic therapies within scope of practice and according to departmental and institutional guidelines.

  • Respond to acute changes in patient condition and serve as a clinical responder for floor pulmonary patients during Rapid Response and Code Blue activations, initiating emergency or life-sustaining interventions per BLS / ACLS protocols and coordinating timely ICU upgrade when indicated.

  • Facilitate timely discharge planning, including patient education, medication reconciliation, home oxygen qualification, DME coordination, and coordination with case management and post-acute care services.

  • Document all patient encounters clearly and accurately in the electronic medical record (Epic).

  • Support a physician-billed care model in which the collaborating Pulmonologist personally performs and documents the history and physical examination and the medical decision-making for each encounter and serves as the billing provider. APP notes are structured to support physician evaluation and management documentation, with the collaborating physician personally appending an attestation confirming participation in the history and physical examination and performance of the medical decision-making for each encounter billed under the physician's NPI.

Patient & Family Education

  • Educate patients and families regarding pulmonary diagnoses, treatment plans, procedures, medications, oxygen therapy, inhaler technique, action plans, and post-discharge expectations.

  • Provide counseling related to disease management, smoking cessation, and respiratory therapies (CPAP/BiPAP adherence, airway clearance regimens).

  • Ensure patient understanding and adherence to care plans, including teach-back verification at discharge.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as a liaison between physicians, nursing staff, respiratory therapy, consulting services, and ancillary departments.

  • Request and coordinate specialty consultations as appropriate, including Interventional Pulmonology, Thoracic Surgery, Interventional Radiology, Oncology, Palliative Care, and Pulmonary Rehabilitation.

  • Coordinate scheduling for inpatient bronchoscopy, EBUS-TBNA, navigational bronchoscopy, thoracentesis, and chest tube placement.

  • Refer eligible patients to the weekly Thoracic Oncology / Lung Cancer Conference (Thursdays) and ensure required imaging and pathology are uploaded prior to discussion.

  • Communicate effectively with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare providers regarding patient status and plan of care.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, policy development, and practice guideline review specific to inpatient pulmonary care.

Qualifications

Education

  • MSN (Nurse Practitioner) or MPAS (Physician Assistant) or equivalent required.

  • Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (AGACNP) track strongly preferred for the inpatient scope; FNP considered with relevant inpatient experience.

Licensure & Certification

  • Active, unrestricted Commonwealth of Virginia Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant license required.

  • National board certification (AACN, ANCC, or NCCPA) required.

  • Active DEA registration required.

  • AHA BLS Provider CPR required.

  • AHA Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) required.

title: Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer
description:
VirtuCrypt is seeking a Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer to design, operate, and scale our global Kubernetes infrastructure. Our clusters span multiple datacenters and deployment stages (development, QA, staging, and production), with production systems operating in FIPS and PCI-validated environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and automate RKE2-based Kubernetes clusters with Rancher.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex networking, routing, VLAN, VIP, and firewall issues.
  • Integrate Kubernetes clusters with the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Loki).
  • Ensure production environments meet strict security and compliance standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application deployments and platform improvements.

Requirements

  • 5 years proven expertise in Kubernetes administration (RKE2/Rancher experience strongly preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure automation.
  • Strong background in networking across complex, multi-datacenter environments.
  • Familiarity with VMware infrastructure (vSphere/ESXi).
  • Experience operating in regulated environments (FIPS, PCI, or similar).
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on scalability and reliability.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g., Argo CD, Flux).
  • Familiarity with container security tools (e.g., Falco, Trivy, Aqua).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, or Go).
  • Knowledge of service meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Background in high availability and disaster recovery strategies for Kubernetes.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, vision, life, and short/long-term disability insurance
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
  • Competitive compensation and opportunities for advancement
  • Retirement plan with employer contribution match
  • Scenic corporate campus with amenities including a tennis court, jogging trail, and putting green
  • Welcoming, family-style corporate culture uniquely suited to fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and motivated individuals

title: VP Programmes - Portfolio and Strategy
description:
Job Description

VP Programmes – Portfolio and Strategy

Derby (Hybrid - 3 days a week on site)

Full time

We are pleased to be able to offer an exciting opportunity for a VP Programmes – Portfolio and Strategy to join the Team in Derby. This is a Senior Leadership role reporting into the SVP – Business Development and Capability.

This VP Programmes – Portfolio and Strategy role is accountable for shaping, mobilising and governing strategic MRO and capability programmes from early definition through to execution. It will also apply control and governance to ensure delivery of a complex Aftermarket Operations portfolio within capital, engineering spend and resource commitments. It includes ownership of translating uncertain strategy, SIOP demand signals and business development activity into executable, governed programmes.

Ideally, you will have experience working in the Civil Aerospace MRO business to be able to quickly understand and influence the Aftermarket Operations portfolio, support prioritisation decisions and make an immediate impact. The Aftermarket Operations portfolio is currently going through a period of growth and this role is critical to ensuring we make the best decisions, supported by the required resource and investment. The role will also be accountable for leading and maturing the Project and Programme Management capability across Aftermarket Operations, defining standards, embedding governance and strengthening risk management to enable consistent, high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

What you will be doing:

The VP Programmes – Portfolio and Strategy role will provide day-to-day leadership of portfolio shaping, prioritisation, governance and performance, ensuring alignment to Civil Aerospace strategic objectives. You will balance transformation, MRO capability growth, and business-as-usual delivery to optimise return on investment. You’ll play a leading role in developing and influencing portfolio investment recommendations and decisions in conjunction with Civil Portfolio Planning:

  • Define, implement and continuously evolve governance frameworks across Aftermarket Operations, ensuring clear accountability, effective decision-making and control of the full investment portfolio, including capital, engineering spend and resource deployment.
  • Lead identification, assessment and active management of portfolio risks, threats and opportunities, ensuring timely interventions and alignment of mitigation actions with changing SIOP demand, operational constraints and business priorities.
  • Influence and align senior stakeholders (internal and external) resolving conflicts and driving agreement to enable timely and effective decision-making on MRO strategy, portfolio priorities and investments.
  • Lead coordination and integration across the portfolio, managing interdependencies and ensuring optimal allocation of financial, engineering and operational resources to maximise delivery performance and return on investment.
  • Lead a small portfolio of Aftermarket Operations enabling projects and process improvements.
  • Lead, develop and grow the Aftermarket Operations PMO, building capability, setting clear expectations and enabling high performance through coaching, structured planning and robust prioritisation.
  • Drive a high-performance, professional programme management culture across Aftermarket Operations, embedding standards, discipline and continuous improvement to enhance overall portfolio delivery effectiveness.

Preferred requirements:

  • Can demonstrate behaviours that meet the six R-R leadership expectations
  • Ideally a member of a professional body or working to achieve an IPMA Level B or Chartered Qualification (Check PMI equivalent)
  • Has demonstrable experience in the management of programmes / projects of increasing complexity and has successfully delivered Level B complexity projects. Have worked in a programme or portfolio environment.
  • Ideally has experience in all stages of a programme lifecycle and has been responsible for the delivery of one or more of those stages.
  • Demonstrable experience of leading large, multi-faceted globally distributed teams towards effective delivery of complex business requirements
  • Good interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex information with individuals at all levels within the organisation.
  • Degree qualified or equivalent industry experience.

Job Summary:

The Associate Dean of Operations & External Relations is a senior level administrator providing overall management and direction across Extension's internal operations, policy development, and external relations, including both elected and nonelected county, state, federal, and tribal partners. This role will collaborate with and report to the Dean of UW-Madison's Division of Extension. The Associate Dean will supervise two Assistant Deans responsible for oversight of Extension’s partnerships and program delivery across all 72 counties in Wisconsin. The Associate Dean also supervises the Directors of units providing division-wide services including human resources, communications, information technology, access and inclusion, and finance, as well as specialists responsible for facilities, planning, policy and administrative management.

Successful applicants will need to have significant work experience as an organizational leader as they step into working as part of leadership within Extension to create the conditions that facilitate effective delivery of Extension education across Wisconsin.

Principle Duties

The Associate Dean of Operations & External Relations will be responsible for performing the following tasks:

Organizational Strategy and Decision-Making

  • Provide strategic insight and direction for operations, policy development, and external relations.

  • As part of leadership, assess how to efficiently and effectively support the delivery of Extension programming across Wisconsin.

  • Maintain policies and procedures, and develop systems to support overall Extension operations including strategic planning, division-wide policy development and management, personnel management, technology, budget, facilities, and internal and external communications.

Divisional Leadership

  • Work in partnership with the Academic Associate Deans in providing critical support for their programming priorities.

  • Work with the Assistant Deans to engage external partners to solicit their needs and priorities, and align them with Extension capacity and expertise.

  • Work with the operations units and specialists to streamline services and align work to address customer needs and priorities in the areas of budget, human resources, communications, information technology, access and inclusion, facilities, planning, and policy.

  • Serve as a core member of the Deans Executive Team by contributing to and developing policies and strategies to advance Extension’s work.

Partnership Management

  • Align annual strategic initiatives in coordination with Assistant Deans and Operational units.

  • Regularly engage with administrative leadership at UW-Madison, including the Offices of: Legal Affairs, University Relations, the Provost, the Chancellor, Risk Management, the Comptroller, and others as needed to address issues and ensure alignment between Extension and campus.

  • Engage with administrative leaders in other Schools, Colleges and Divisions on campus to work on issues of share interest and/or impact.

Budget Management

  • Manage overall budget for Operations and the Dean’s Office.

  • Develop strategies to diversify funding sources for Extension’s priorities.

Staff Management

  • Supervise Operation Directors, Assistant Deans for Geographies, and operations specialists.

External Relations

  • Build relationships with federal, state, local and tribal officials to address mutual priorities and secure external funding.

  • Engage with administrative leadership of other Extension organizations, particularly those in the North Central region.

  • Develop new and strengthen existing key strategic partnerships with nonprofit and nongovernment organizations.

Statewide Location

Division of Extension headquarters are located within Madison, WI

Partial Remote

This position may require some work to be performed in-person, onsite, at a designated campus work location. Some work may be performed remotely, at an offsite, non-campus work location. Remote work requires an approved remote work agreement (RWA). A RWA requires successful candidates to possess their own high-speed internet and phone to perform the work on a university provided computer. Per University policy, transportation between home and assigned work location is not payable/reimbursable and will be at the expense of the employee.

This position has the possibility of working up to 2 days remote per week.

Evening/Weekend Work

It is expected that employees will make individual arrangements for transportation adequate to meet position responsibilities and essential job functions. Read more about UW-Madison Driver Authorization.

title: Clinical Lab Scientist - Core Lab DAYS-
description:
Your job is more than a job.

The Clinical Laboratory Scientist performs clinical laboratory testing of blood and body fluid constituents as requested by physicians. Evaluates and reports data for use in diagnosis and treatment of disease. Operates, controls and troubleshoots clinical laboratory equipment.

Your Everyday

Ensures specimens received by the laboratory are acceptable for testing by applying the appropriate criteria. Changes or prepares reagents, controls as necessary and records such in log. Labels, accessions and distributes specimens so that integrity of patient identification is maintained throughout processing. Inoculates specimens from all areas of the body on appropriate media. Initiates orders for blood and/or blood components from the appropriate blood supplier. Follows hospital/laboratory safety and infection control policies and reports variances to section supervisors as they occur.

Operates both primary and secondary instrumentation proficiently. Determines appropriateness of manual methods, micro-methods, back-up procedures and initiates such procedures. Through use of the computer system, compares patient results to previous results during the same encounter and investigates discrepancies. Reports test results within established departmental turn-around times after verifying documentation is complete and accurate.

Prepares and interprets gram stains and other wet and dry preparations for bacteriology and parasitology. Performs all routine procedures including, but not limited to, ABORH typing and retesting, antibody detection and identification, compatibility testing and serology procedures. Prepares blood components while maintaining aseptic technique and proper storage. Evaluates serological reactivity to assist with antibody identification and crossmatch incompatibilities. Follows universal precautions at all times when dealing with blood or body fluids. Disinfects counter tops at the end of the shift with appropriate cleaner.


Operates, calibrates, conducts performance checks and maintains any clinical laboratory instrument or equipment after orientation. Troubleshoots basic instrument malfunctions and documents in the appropriate action log. Determines when an instrument’s service representative should be contacted for assistance. Analyzes quality control material for each procedure, records values according to section policy and reports to technical Supervisor when results are outside established limits. Performs comparison studies of precision, accuracy and linearity on new or existing procedures and reports results by established deadlines. Performs and accurately records proficiency surveys, properly routes form and copies within the specified time frame. Performs all aspects of reagent quality control as specified in the quality control manuals. Assists in the clinical orientation of new or less skilled laboratory personnel as requested by the section Supervisor. Assures proper packaging and disposal of waste chemicals. Maintains proper documentation (log) of generated waste.


Performs order or result entry (manual or computerized) and reviews information for accuracy before verification. Documents Critical Call Value notification, duplicate checking, date and time of performance, technologist initials and expected age related “normal” values on all down-time reports as appropriate.


Checks instruments and benches assigned for appropriate reagent and supply levels and replenishes when necessary. Notifies appropriate person of low inventory items or of any out-of-date reagents contaminated or otherwise unacceptable. Records receipt of supplies and reagents, properly initialing and dating the inventory items at receipt, time put into use and expiration. Ensures adequate inventory levels are available for incoming shifts.

Receives tissue specimens from surgery, autopsy and the nursing floors. Performs proper processing and preservation of tissue specimens. Complies with proper specimen storage and preservation of all other non-tissue specimens for non-core laboratory. Prepares necessary reagents and collection supplies for assisting with bone marrow aspirations according to physician orders. Assists physicians in the procurement of bone marrow specimens in accordance with departmental and Hospital policies. Performs special stains and follows protocols as appropriate.

The Must-Haves

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Clinical Lab Generalist licensed by Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners as CLG or CLS

WORK SHIFT:

Days (United States of America)

title: Biostatistics Director
description:
The Cystic Fibrosis Foundation is a leading healthcare nonprofit organization like no other. For decades, we have been taking major steps and pioneering new ways to advance the mission to find a cure for cystic fibrosis and to provide all people with CF the opportunity to lead long, fulfilling lives by funding research and drug development, partnering with the CF community, and advancing high-quality, specialized care.

By joining the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, you will be part of a dedicated team committed to our core values and working towards a cure for cystic fibrosis. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of those affected by CF. Learn more about why work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation.

Position Summary:

The Biostatistics Director will be responsible for developing high-quality evidence to support CFF's mission to advance high-quality specialized care for all individuals with CF. Additionally, they will expand the impact of the data in the CF Foundation Patient Registry (CFFPR) by enabling additional research through data linkages and harmonization and by increasing quality through quality controls and standardization protocols. They will oversee the process by which external investigators request Registry data for research and provide statistical and epidemiologic methods expertise to both CFF staff activities and external stakeholders. The Biostatistics Director will also provide technical support in the development of the Next Generation Patient Registry. The Director of Biostatistics will be responsible for thinking strategically about opportunities to enhance research capabilities that further expand our understanding of CF and CF care.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the application of state-of-the-art statistical methods to conduct analyses to address research questions using data from the CF Foundation Patient Registry.
  • Provide statistical expertise in the design and analysis of real-world research studies.
  • Disseminate study findings through conference presentations, posters, and collaborative development of manuscripts.
  • Review and evaluate research proposals for CFF Patient Registry data from external investigators.
  • Manage and support biostatisticians / data analysts.
  • Support enhancement of the CFFPR data through improvements in the registry and linkage to other data sources.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • MPH/MS Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Demography, or other similar quantitative field of study (Required)
  • PhD/DSc Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Demography, or other similar quantitative field of study (Preferred)
  • 10+ years Relevant work experience
  • 5+ years Managing staff
  • Experience with secondary data analysis study design and analytic methods, including longitudinal modeling, causal inference, and time-to-event analyses.
  • Experience with registries or other large observational data sets.
  • Prior experience with peer-review publication process.
  • Experience with electronic health record data. (Preferred)
  • Proficiency in SAS and R; knowledgeable proficiency with SQL.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple daily tasks, and shift priorities as needed.
  • Familiar with IRB review process and human subjects research protections.
  • Strong attention to detail and organization skills.
  • Robust writing and communication skills, including the ability to discuss statistical concepts with clinicians, people with CF, and their family members.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills with both in-person and remote colleagues.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:

  • This position reports to the Senior Director of Patient Registry and Real-World Evidence.
  • This role will oversee a team of 4-6 clinical data analysts.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, and temperature.
  • No heavy lifting required.
  • Minimal travel (e.g., 4x/yr.) to conferences and meetings, as necessary.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 days or until the position is filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, so candidates are encouraged to apply promptly if interested.

The salary range is $170,800.00 to $213,400.00. Specific salary varies based on geographic location and is commensurate with experience.

Total Rewards: The CF Foundation is committed to offering competitive compensation (base pay and incentive), benefits, time off and professional development opportunities that maximize our ability to recruit, retain, reward, and motivate a highly qualified and diverse workforce. Visit our Why Work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation for detailed total rewards information.

The CF Foundation is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to being an employer of choice, not just a good place to work, but a great and inclusive place to work. We strive to recruit and maintain a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, physical or mental disability, color, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, sex, pregnancy, marital status, genetic information or testing, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran or any characteristic protected by law.

title: Trainer Specialist APAC-
description:
Role Overview

About the Role

We’re looking for a Trainer Specialist to design, deliver, and continuously improve training programs for Stakeholder and Land Management Software customers, partners, and internal stakeholders across the APAC region.

You’ll be the face of product training and enablement in the region — delivering live and virtual sessions, creating self-serve learning content, and working cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with product releases.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working across multiple countries, time zones, and languages, with a passion for making complex software easy to learn.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver Training

  • Lead live, in-person, and virtual onboarding and product training sessions for new and existing customers, partners, and resellers across APAC markets.
  • Deliver engaging, practical training tailored to different audiences, including end users, administrators, partners, and resellers.
  • Support customers throughout their learning journey to help drive product confidence, adoption, and successful outcomes.

Develop Learning Content

  • Work closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Customer Success teams to develop effective training materials.
  • Create and maintain a range of learning resources, including user guides, videos, e-learning modules, quick-reference guides, and other self-serve content.
  • Tailor learning materials to different audiences, roles, and levels of product knowledge.

Localize and Adapt Training

  • Adapt training content and delivery approaches to reflect cultural, regional, and language differences across APAC markets.
  • Ensure training is relevant and accessible to customers and partners across markets, including Australia and New Zealand.

Support Product Launches

  • Partner with Product and Product Marketing teams to develop training plans for new features and product releases.
  • Create and deliver training content ahead of product launches and go-live dates.
  • Ensure customers, partners, and internal teams are prepared to confidently adopt new functionality.

Measure Training Effectiveness

  • Track and report on training effectiveness using metrics such as certification completion rates, customer feedback, support ticket trends, and product adoption.
  • Use insights and feedback to continuously improve training programs, content, and delivery methods.

Collaborate on the LMS

  • Work with the Enablement team to maintain and update courses within the learning management system (LMS).
  • Ensure training content remains accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with product changes.

Enable Internal Teams

  • Train Customer Success, Support, and Sales teams on new features, product updates, and best practices.
  • Equip internal teams with the knowledge and resources they need to confidently support and educate customers.

Gather and Share Feedback

  • Act as a voice of the customer by identifying recurring training challenges, knowledge gaps, and content needs.
  • Share insights and feedback with Product, Enablement, and other relevant teams to help improve the overall customer experience.

Scale Train-the-Trainer Programs

  • Where applicable, develop and deliver train-the-trainer programs for partners and resellers.
  • Certify partner and reseller trainers to independently deliver Stakeholder and Land Management Software training in their local markets.

Engagement Type and Compensation

This role will be engaged on an independent contractor basis, with a base fee of AUD [91,000], exclusive of superannuation and other employee entitlements.

As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for managing your own income tax, GST, and any other applicable statutory obligations. Whether the agreed fee is GST-inclusive or GST-exclusive will be confirmed based on your GST registration status.

How You'll Work

As an independent contractor, you will have autonomy over how and when the work is delivered, provided that the agreed scope, deliverables, deadlines, and requirements are met.

You should hold, or be prepared to establish, a personal Australian Business Number (ABN) or an appropriate company entity through which invoices can be issued.

Where company-provided equipment, systems, meetings, or scheduling arrangements are required, these will be structured, where reasonably practicable, to support and maintain a genuine independent contracting relationship.

Before You Start

Before the engagement commences, we will confirm and document:

  • Your ABN or company registration details;
  • Your GST registration status;
  • Your invoicing and payment details;
  • The agreed base fee;
  • The scope of services and deliverables;
  • Applicable deadlines and requirements; and
  • Whether the agreed fee is GST-inclusive or GST-exclusive.

These details will be incorporated into the Independent Contractor Agreement, which will be reviewed by HR and Legal to ensure the engagement is structured in accordance with applicable Australian requirements.

Contractor Responsibilities

As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for:

  • Maintaining your ABN or company registration, as applicable;
  • Meeting your own tax, GST, insurance, and other statutory obligations;
  • Issuing valid invoices in accordance with the agreed payment terms; and
  • Performing the agreed services and delivering the required outcomes within the agreed timeframes.

The parties acknowledge that the engagement is intended to operate as an independent contractor arrangement and not as an employment relationship, subject to the terms of the final agreement and applicable Australian law.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of experience in training, enablement, customer education, instructional design, or a related role, ideally within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience designing and delivering both live and virtual training, as well as self-paced e-learning content.
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working across APAC time zones, cultures, and diverse customer environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) and content creation tools such as Articulate, Camtasia, and Loom.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Additional language proficiency relevant to APAC markets.
  • Experience delivering training for technical or workflow-based SaaS products.
  • Experience working with partners or resellers in a train-the-trainer capacity.
  • Familiarity with land management, stakeholder engagement, right-of-way, or utility industry software and workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers and partners across APAC consistently provide strong feedback and ratings for onboarding and training experiences.
  • Training content is accurate, current, and updated in line with major product releases.
  • Support ticket volume related to “how-to” questions trends downward as customers increasingly adopt self-serve learning resources.
  • Customer Success, Support, and Sales teams feel confident and well-equipped following product update and enablement training.
  • Partners and resellers are able to independently deliver high-quality product training in their local markets where train-the-trainer programs are established.

Why Join Irth Solutions

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company expanding its Stakeholder and Land Management Software footprint across Asia-Pacific.
  • Help build and shape a regional training and enablement function from the ground up, with meaningful influence over how it scales.
  • Work with a collaborative, cross-functional team across Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Enablement.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, benefits, and flexible or hybrid work options.

Equal Opportunity

Irth Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team across the APAC region.

AI Use in Hiring

As part of our hiring process, this role may use artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist in reviewing and screening applications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment in hiring decisions.

Role Type

This is a new position.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is AUS $91,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.

Benefits

    • Competitive Salary
    • Comprehensive Benefits Package including generous medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match
    • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to support work-life balance
    • Paid Holidays annually
    • Work-from-Home Flexibility available for eligible positions
    • Supportive Work Environment focused on employee growth and well-being

title: Sr. Principal Engineer - Automation Engineering – Small Molecule, Lilly Medicine Foundry
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Organization and Position Overview

Lilly recently announced a $4.5 billion investment to create the Lilly Medicine Foundry, a new center for advanced manufacturing and drug development. The first-ever facility of its kind, combining research and manufacturing in a single location, the Medicine Foundry will allow Lilly to further develop innovative solutions to optimize manufacturing processes and increase capacity for clinical trial medicines, while also reducing costs and environmental impact.

The Sr. Principal Engineer - Automation Engineering will work as a member of the Automation Engineering Department at Eli Lilly, Foundry. The Sr. Principal engineer will provide automation support for one or more operating areas across site and/or for capital projects. Process Automation is core to delivering a right first time facility start up and continued support of ongoing manufacturing operations into the future.

The Sr. Principal Engineer is also responsible for the productivity and mentorship of the employees with the purpose of ensuring that reliable and complaint-controlled applications and systems are used in the manufacturing at Foundry. Additionally, the Sr. Principal Engineer, as a key technical expert partners to influence and implement within the process control organization and across functional disciplines to support the process control technical agenda, business plan priorities, and compliance objectives.

In the project delivery phase and startup phase of the project (startup expected 2025 to 2028), automation engineering roles will be fluid and dynamic as we endeavor to support the project delivery, build a new organization, develop and implement the necessary systems and business processes required to support GMP operations, and build the site culture. This will require significant collaboration, creativity and resilience as the site grows to a full scale GMP manufacturing through start up.

Responsibilities

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor process control team, including design, controls philosophy, implementation and commissioning
  • Process control work implementation and coordination
  • Review and monitor financial performance; commit to meeting targets
  • Develop and implement the Automation Engineering Project Plan.

Operational Excellence

  • Technically lead and oversee the work of Site Area leads and System Integrator including Functional Requirements, Design Specifications, DCS Application Software, Test Specifications.
  • Lead/Participate in design reviews and DeltaV application software reviews, attend equipment and software FATs
  • Lead a team of automation engineers supporting commissioning
  • Provide periodic status updates to Project Management
  • Devise functional requirements and process control strategies for control systems in collaboration with Process Engineering
  • DCS and SCADA software design, coding/configuration and testing (sequence logic, graphics, batch software etc.)
  • Perform automation engineering activities including design, tuning and troubleshooting of control loops
  • Implement and support electronic systems (such as plant historians, applications and software integration) used to capture process automation related production data
  • Maintain the validated state of the site control systems in line with Lilly quality standards including the development and execution of validation strategies and associated documentation
  • Automation support for capital projects including new product introductions
  • Promoting the use of automation to improve productivity, operational efficiency and compliance
  • Developing a ‘network’ of corporate contacts and leveraging corporate expertise when needed

Organizational Capability

  • In coordination with automation and compliance consultants, set and reinforce standards for appropriate rigor in automation work products.
  • Demonstrated initiative, good planning and organizational skills, ability to prioritize tasks, commitment to task completion and timelines.
  • Possess a keen technical curiosity and has demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and a desire for continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to influence peers and business partners
  • Good written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Support the flow leadership in running the plant, including participation in management sub-teams.
  • Knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, computer system validation

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum B.S. in Engineering or related discipline and 8+ years working experience in Automation Engineering, preferably in Small Molecule or Biologics.
  • Experience in design, development, commissioning and qualification of highly automated greenfield or brownfield manufacturing sites utilizing SCADA, DCS, PLC and MES systems (DeltaV, Rockwell, Syncade, etc).
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Preferences:

  • Experience working with kilo or high potency labs highly preferred. Experience with peptides, oligonucleotides, or ADC’s (antibody drug conjugates) preferred
  • Experience in facilitating and driving decision-making at an organizational level.
  • Ability to instill teamwork within the department and demonstrate key interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in DeltaV Distributed Control System, Rockwell Allen-Bradley PLC, and batch process automation.
  • Experience with ISA-88 Batch-control standard models, terminology, recipes and procedural elements.
  • Prior work with 21 CFR Part 11 and cGMP regulatory requirements, including computer system validation.
  • Proven ability to influence peers and business partners, including influencing without authority, and to facilitate decision-making at an organizational level.

Other Information:

  • Initial location at Parkwood West, Indianapolis.
  • Permanent location at the new Lilly Medicines Foundry in Lebanon, Indiana.
  • Travel Percentage: Some travel required to support equipment/software Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), typically at vendor or system integrator sites.
  • Act as an escalation resource for complex operational and process inquiries, delivering advanced support and issue resolution as business needs arise. Need-based off-hour support may be needed.

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




What will you contribute?


As a Expert Storage Systems Engineer, you will serve as the recognized technical expert for enterprise storage platforms, with deep expertise across NetApp technologies including NetApp CVO (Cloud Volumes ONTAP), NetApp on‑premises arrays, and Azure NetApp Files. You will design, operate, and optimize global storage infrastructures that support mission‑critical workloads across hybrid environments.
In this role, you will drive strategy, architecture, performance engineering, automation, and modernisation initiatives, helping shape the technical direction for storage services across the organization. You will collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, cloud, operations, and architecture teams to deliver innovative, scalable, and resilient storage solutions.
Your contribution will include providing technical thought leadership, solving complex problems with broad business impact, and influencing storage strategy and standards across multiple products and business segments.

Responsibilities & Deliverables:

Architecture & Design
- Lead architecture, design, and capacity planning of storage platforms including NetApp CVO, on‑premises NetApp systems, and Azure NetApp Files.
- Develop and maintain storage service roadmaps, standards, best practices, and automation frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
- Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to enhance performance, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.

Implementation & Operations
- Oversee deployment, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management of enterprise storage systems across on‑prem and cloud environments.
- Ensure top‑quality delivery of storage‑related projects, collaborating closely with project managers and engineering teams.
- Drive troubleshooting, root‑cause analysis, and resolution of complex performance or availability issues affecting storage services.

Automation, Optimization & Monitoring
- Develop automation to streamline provisioning, data protection, and DR workflows.
- Optimize storage performance, cost, and efficiency, leveraging analytics, telemetry, and capacity forecasting tools.
- Integrate storage platforms with enterprise monitoring systems, ensuring complete observability across all tiers.

Collaboration & Leadership
- Act as a technical advisor to cloud, compute, database, and operations teams during design, implementation, and incident response.
- Lead complex technical initiatives with organization‑wide impact, providing guidance across multiple products and business segments.
- Communicate complex ideas and influence senior stakeholders to adopt recommended solutions and strategies.

Documentation & Compliance
-Produce and maintain architecture documents, runbooks, technical specifications, testing protocols, and operational guides.
-Ensure alignment with ITIL practices, including change, incident, and problem management workflows.
-Support audit and compliance initiatives for infrastructure controls and data protection.

title: Director of People and Culture
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

No matter the season, Jackson Hole offers a lifestyle built around outdoor adventure, meaningful connections, and unforgettable moments. Surrounded by the iconic peaks of Grand Teton and the natural beauty of nearby Yellowstone National Park, Four Seasons Resort and Residences Jackson Hole offers more than a workplace. It’s an inspiring place to grow your career, build community, and explore year-round. From world renowned skiing and snowboarding in the winter to hiking, wildlife viewing, and endless outdoor recreation throughout the warmer months, there’s always something new to discover in heart of the American West.

Responsibilities

  • The Director of People & Culture is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the People & Culture division, including benefits administration, employee relations, housing, talent acquisition, retention, employee communications, career development, wage and hour compliance, training, workers’ compensation, and employment-related legal matters.
  • Monitor the quality and effectiveness of staff performance, including oversight of disciplinary actions, recommendations for suspension or termination, and the establishment and administration of regular performance appraisal programs.
  • Assess the development and effectiveness of employees at all levels and evaluate the hotel’s workforce needs through succession planning, career planning, and coaching and counseling in partnership with leadership.
  • Oversee the financial aspects of the People & Culture budget, including benefits, labor and salary reporting, and the planning of cost-effective employee events and initiatives within established budget guidelines.
  • Establish and implement recruitment, selection, placement, and pre-employment procedures in accordance with Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts’ policies, staffing guidelines, compensation practices, and all applicable laws.
  • Analyze the hotel’s training and development needs at all levels and create or coordinate programs that ensure employees are proficient in delivering Four Seasons core standards and culture, while supporting career growth and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Lead and support employee Wellness programs and Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging initiatives that foster an inclusive, engaged, and healthy workplace culture.
  • Serve as both a strategic leader and hands-on partner to hotel leadership, balancing long-term People & Culture objectives with day-to-day operational needs.
  • Maintain a high degree of integrity, discretion, and professionalism while overseeing employee-related matters and supporting a positive experience within all Heart of the House areas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a Director of People & Culture or Assistant Director of People & Culture role is required, preferably within a luxury hotel environment.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or four-year degree is strongly preferred.
  • A background in Human Resources, Education, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong experience in Human Resources leadership and strategy, employee relations and engagement, talent acquisition, learning and development, labor relations, and total rewards.
  • Experience with HRIS and payroll systems required; Workday and ADP experience preferred.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to understand and manage strategic financial planning, budgeting, labor costs, and compensation practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, conflict-resolution, and strategic-thinking skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build strong relationships at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, discretion, and integrity when handling sensitive employee and business matters.
  • Flexible schedule with the ability to work all shifts, weekends, and holidays as necessary.
  • Passion for service and a commitment to delivering an exceptional employee experience within a luxury hospitality environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
description:
About CORTO

We are CORTO, a cutting-edge software company dedicated to revolutionising the legal industry. Our mission is to empower legal practitioners with AI-driven solutions that streamline their workflow, boost productivity, and provide more efficient client service.

Our team of AI experts and engineers collaborate to develop intelligent software tailored to the unique needs of lawyers, paralegals, and legal assistants.

Our innovative AI solutions automate routine tasks, simplify document management, and enhance decision-making, allowing legal professionals to focus on what they do best—providing expert legal counsel.

We’re rapidly scaling from 80 to 150+ employees, with a highly technical workforce where around 90% of the team are developers and engineers. Working alongside our Sydney-based team of passionate high achievers, you’ll join a fast-growing technology business where things rarely stay the same for long - and if you’re smart, caring, and ambitious, you’ll be in great company.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our Backend Team. In this role, you will work on all the backend APIs and services that make up the core of CORTO. Working closely with the Head of Backend Engineering, you will play a key role in building and evolving our backend applications to drive innovation and performance.

This is an incredible opportunity to be part of an engineering team building the next generation of our products.

To make this happen you will

  • Develop, test, and maintain backend applications using C# and .NET technologies
  • Work extensively with AWS, including S3, SNS, SQS, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and more
  • Work on prompt engineering with OpenAI
  • Optimize code for performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver efficient solutions

What you’ll bring

You are a focused, motivated and hard-working developer who wants to join a fantastic growing team at a critical time and learn on the job to expand your skills. In addition to that you will bring:

  • Demonstrated skills with ASP.NET Web API with a minimum of 3 years' experience
  • Excellent knowledge of REST services
  • Experience with MS SQL, PostgreSQL or any other relational database
  • Good knowledge of SOLID principles
  • Experience with DynamoDB or any other NoSQL database
  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud computing platforms

You are the type of person who

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Positive attitude – things might not always go as expected but we maintain optimism and win, nonetheless
  • Being a team player – we reach our goals together and help each other to succeed

CORTO is an inclusive, people-first company committed to breaking down institutional barriers that keep people from reaching their potential. If you meet some, but not all the requirements above, we encourage you to still submit your application.

Why join CORTO?

  • Your work matters. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
  • Make an impact. You won’t be another ‘cog in the wheel’ here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects – and to make a real difference.
  • Work with a group of authentic, passionate people who love what they do.
  • Well-funded and global. CORTO is part of ATI Global – one of the largest international LegalTech companies.
  • Flexible and hybrid working. We engage, share, and collaborate on ideas and workflows.
  • Career and learning opportunities - we move fast and need smart people to get us where we're going. We are a scaling business and looking for people who want to grow with us.
  • Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
  • We value your well-being with additional time off, gym membership and other perks.
  • Fast-paced tech environment, if we don't disrupt ourselves someone else will do it!
  • Access to LEAP Home - a program unique to the ATI Group to support you in buying your primary residence.

title: Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
About DAT

title: Senior GNC Software Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our Battelspace Awareness Command and Control Software team specializes in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in path planning, route optimization, and autonomous mission execution at the command and control layer. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Define and influence the direction of a small team within the Command and Control Software organization, leveraging your subject-matter expertise in path planning and route optimization.

  • Prototype and deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for global and local path planning, trajectory optimization, and multi-agent coordination within command and control systems.

  • Develop high-performance software for real-time C2 systems, ranging from operator-facing mission planning tools to autonomous tasking and routing services that orchestrate fleets of unmanned platforms.

  • Design and implement robust planners, search algorithms, and decision-making systems that generate safe, feasible, and optimal routes in dynamic, uncertain, and contested environments.

  • Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate planner behavior across diverse mission scenarios.

  • Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including collaborative autonomy, asset routing, and obstacle and threat avoidance.

  • Integrate path planning technologies into the broader command and control software stack and development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.

  • Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues, operators, and end-users.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience in algorithm design, software development, and mathematical modeling with programming expertise in C/C++, Python, and Matlab.

  • Strong knowledge of path planning techniques, such as graph-based search (A*, D* Lite), sampling-based planners (RRT, RRT*, PRM), and lattice or grid-based planners.

  • Demonstrated experience in guidance, navigation, and control (GNC); trajectory optimization; and/or the development of predictive models for vehicle dynamics and weapon system effectiveness (e.g., 6-DoF simulation, intercept analysis).

  • Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, computational geometry, and graph theory.

  • Knowledge of vehicle dynamics, kinematic constraints, and control theory as applied to autonomous ground, air, or maritime platforms tasked through C2 systems.

  • Familiarity with map representations, terrain reasoning, and the efficient handling of large-scale geospatial and environmental data within distributed C2 architectures.

  • Background in machine learning as applied to planning and decision-making, including reinforcement learning, learned heuristics, and behavior prediction.

  • Ability to engineer robust systems for planning under uncertainty, multi-agent coordination, and operation in complex, dynamic, contested environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
