title: Clinical Lab Scientist-Core Lab-PRN
description:
Your job is more than a job.

As a Clinical Laboratory Scientist, you have the uncanny ability to look for that needle in the haystack that may lead to cracking medical mysteries. You’re not looking to be in the limelight, but rather to shed some light on health problems and diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and genetic abnormalities. Blood samples or body fluid specimens can hold the answers to research or recovery, so you take a detailed approach to performing clinical laboratory testing, evaluating and reporting data.

And while you may never actually meet your patients personally, you still feel a connection to a real person that may benefit from your love of science and research. There’s nobody like you and that’s why we’d love to have you be a part of our crack team of scientific sleuths.

Your experiences, your knowledge, your skills, your empathy, your compassion, your personality, all of it adds up to you. And we’re excited to get to know you and find out what you’ll bring to this vital scientific research role.

Your Everyday

Ensure specimens received by the laboratory are acceptable for testing by applying the appropriate criteria and change or prepare reagents, controls as necessary and records such in log.

Label, accession and distribute specimens so that integrity of patient identification is maintained throughout processing and inoculate specimens from all areas of the body on appropriate media.

Initiate orders for blood and/or blood components from the appropriate blood supplier.

Follow hospital/laboratory safety and infection control policies and report variances to section supervisors as they occur.

Determine appropriateness of manual methods, micro-methods, back-up procedures and initiate such procedures.

Use computer system to compare patient results to previous results during the same encounter and investigate discrepancies and report test results within established departmental turn-around times after verifying documentation is complete and accurate.

Prepare and interpret gram stains and other wet and dry preparations for bacteriology and parasitology.

Perform all routine procedures including, but not limited to, ABORH typing and retesting, antibody detection and identification, compatibility testing and serology procedures.

Prepare blood components while maintaining aseptic technique and proper storage.

Evaluate serological reactivity to assist with antibody identification and crossmatch incompatibilities.

Follow universal precautions at all times when dealing with blood or body fluids and disinfect counter tops at the end of the shift with appropriate cleaner.

Operate, calibrate, conduct performance checks, and maintain any clinical laboratory instrument or equipment after orientation, troubleshoot basic instrument malfunctions, and document in the appropriate action log.

Determine when an instrument’s service representative should be contacted for assistance.

Analyze quality control material for each procedure, record values according to section policy, and report to technical supervisor when results are outside established limits.

Perform comparison studies of precision, accuracy and linearity on new or existing procedures, record proficiency surveys, and route form and reagent quality control as specified in the quality control manuals.

Assist in the clinical orientation of new or less skilled laboratory personnel as requested by the section Supervisor. Assures proper packaging and disposal of waste chemicals.

Maintain proper documentation (log) of generated waste.

Perform order or result entry (manual or computerized) and reviews information for accuracy before verification.

Document critical call value notification, duplicate checking, date and time of performance, technologist initials and expected age related “normal” values on all down-time reports as appropriate.

Check instruments and benches assigned for appropriate reagent and supply levels and replenishes and notify appropriate person of low inventory items or of any out-of-date reagents contaminated or otherwise unacceptable, record receipt of supplies and reagents, properly initialing and dating the inventory items at receipt, time put into use and expiration, and ensure adequate inventory levels are available for incoming shifts.

Receive tissue specimens from surgery, autopsy and the nursing floors, perform proper processing and preservation of tissue specimens, comply with proper specimen storage and preservation of all other non-tissue specimens for non-core laboratory.

Prepare necessary reagents and collection supplies for assisting with bone marrow aspirations according to physician orders, assist physicians in the procurement of bone marrow specimens, perform special stains and follow protocols as appropriate.

title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack — Leading Crypto Comparison Platform)
description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.

Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.

Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.

Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales

Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth

⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership

Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus

Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide

All the AI and tools you need to do your best work

Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided

✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch

Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows

Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale

Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed

Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same

A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them

Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners

Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue

Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing

Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API

Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js

Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)

Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions

Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.

Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.

Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.

AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

FHCSD is one of the top 10 largest federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the country. We operate more than 90 sites across San Diego County, including 29 primary care clinics, 23 behavioral health facilities, 10 physical rehabilitation clinics, nine dental clinics, five vision clinics, four outpatient substance use treatment programs, three mobile medical units, two mobile counseling centers, two urgent care centers, and a pharmacy.

title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

InnerPlant is on a mission to transform farming as never before imagined: We give crops a voice by turning plants into living sensors that signal the onset of stress, enabling farmers to increase yields and reduce costs by optimizing inputs.

We're seeking a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer to lead the design, integration, and deployment of electrical systems that power our sensing platforms and field technologies of our commercial product, CropVoice. The CropVoice platform translates signals from our living sensors to pinpoint stress well before visible symptoms, giving farmers and agronomists critical and timely insights and removing the guesswork behind key in-season decisions.

Your Role

As a Senior Electrical Systems Engineer, you'll play a critical role in developing and producing the hardware and systems that detect the optical signals from our living sensors. You will manage hardware, embedded systems, optics, and data acquisition to develop reliable products that operate in demanding agricultural environments. To achieve success as a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will:

  • Lead electrical system architecture for next-generation sensing and imaging platforms.
  • Design analog and digital electronic circuits for embedded hardware and sensor interfaces.
  • Develop robust power distribution, battery management, and power optimization solutions for field-deployed systems.
  • Select components, create schematics, support PCB layout, and oversee prototype builds.
  • Define system-level requirements, interface specifications, and verification plans.
  • Perform hardware validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Support environmental, EMC, reliability, and field testing to ensure dependable operation under real-world agricultural conditions.
  • Manage engineering documentation including design reviews, BOMs, test reports, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Partner with contract manufacturers and suppliers to transition designs into production.

What Makes You Stand Out

The successful Senior Electrical Engineer will be an experienced engineer who enjoys building complex systems from concept through production and thrives in a fast-moving startup environment. In particular, you will:

  • Be forward-thinking with respect to solutions that are scalable and cost-effective for near and long-term commercial objectives, balancing performance, reliability, ease of manufacture, and cost.
  • Collaborate across internal teams, in particular with software, optical, mechanical, and product engineering teams, to deliver integrated hardware solutions.
  • Relentlessly strive for continuous improvement, including design improvements.
  • Mentor junior members of the team and help establish engineering best practices.
  • Communicate cost/reliability tradeoffs of design decisions effectively.

Requirements

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (Masters in EE preferred).
  • 8+ years of experience developing complex electronic systems.
  • Strong experience with mixed-signal circuit design and embedded hardware.
  • Experience designing systems that integrate sensors, imaging devices, communications, or industrial electronics.
  • Experience with embedded Linux or microcontroller-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with wireless communications, GPS/GNSS, or edge computing devices.
  • Experience with cloud computing and fleet management platforms like AWS IoT Core, RemoteIt, etc
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, CAN, or USB.
  • Experience with optical sensing, imaging systems, machine vision, or precision agriculture technologies (preferred).
  • Knowledge of design for manufacturability (DFM), design for test (DFT), and regulatory compliance (preferred).

Benefits

title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
ALL.SPACE is scaling fast and this role will lead that charge. The Chief Growth Officer will take the foundation of ALL.SPACE's revenue generation and scale it into a market-leading commercial engine, with the US defense market as the primary focus. ALL.SPACE is positioned to scale revenue several-fold over the next three years and this role owns the strategy, team and execution to get there.

This role calls for a seasoned commercial executive with a proven record of driving scale in complex, relationship-led markets. The successful candidate leads from the front - a hands-on operator who is as comfortable building relationships directly with customers and partners as they are setting strategy and building a team.

Key Accountabilities:

1. Defense Sales Strategy & Execution

Own ALL.SPACE's commercial strategy across the US Department of Defense, setting the multi-year direction across the Army, Navy, Marine Corps and Space Force and translating it into revenue growth. Act as ALL.SPACE's most senior commercial relationship-holder with DoD, providing direct access to decision-makers from General/Flag Officer level through program and acquisition offices, and shaping ALL.SPACE's position across SATCOM, C2 and adjacent programs of record.

2. Government Relations

Own ALL.SPACE's US government relations strategy, directing internal and external resources - including specialist partners or lobbying capability within the broader York Space Systems group - to influence acquisition and budget outcomes at the congressional and Pentagon level. This is a directing role: the accountability is for the strategy and its results, not for executing every element personally.

3. Channel & Partner Strategy

Own the full commercial channel across ALL.SPACE's global markets, direct and indirect, structuring how ALL.SPACE sells through prime contractors, satellite operators and industry integrators. Build a structured partner program - tiering, incentives, enablement - that extends ALL.SPACE's market reach and revenue beyond what a direct sales effort alone could achieve.

4. Global Government Expansion

Own ALL.SPACE's international government sales and business development strategy as the company scales beyond the US, with initial focus on NATO and Five Eyes nations, extending the same commercial model applied domestically into new markets.

5. Commercial Operations

Accountable for the discipline and governance of the commercial function overall - process, forecasting, budgeting and CRM - ensuring the Executive Leadership Team and board have a reliable view of revenue performance and pipeline health.

6. Thought Leadership & Industry Representation

Build ALL.SPACE's profile through thought leadership - speaking engagements, panels and media - at industry and government events, and through association, advisory and business/government engagement opportunities that position the company and its leadership as an industry authority.

7. Executive Leadership

Sit on the Executive Leadership Team, sharing accountability for company-wide strategy and performance beyond the commercial remit.

Requirements

  • A proven record of scaling revenue in the US defense market.
  • Established credibility across the Army, Navy, Marine Corps and Space Force, from senior leadership through program and acquisition offices, with a track record of direct access to decision-makers.
  • Working knowledge of the DoD acquisition system and budget process.
  • A demonstrable record of congressional and Pentagon engagement success.
  • Experience building and managing indirect/partner channels with primes, satellite operators, and integrators.
  • International defense sales experience, direct and indirect, including NATO/Five Eyes or comparable markets.
  • Experience owning sales operations, CRM discipline and forecasting/budgeting rigor.
  • Experience owning or closely partnering with marketing and PR functions.
  • Prior experience operating at C-suite or senior executive team level, accountable for a multi-function commercial organization.
  • An active US security clearance is required.

Travel

High travel expectation. Direct, high-frequency customer, Pentagon, Hill and partner engagement is critical to this role's success.

Benefits

  • Excellent Compensation package inclusive of competitive salary, 401(k) plan, healthcare and 25 days holiday in addition to the US Bank holidays.
  • Bonus package
  • Career development training opportunities (in house and external)
  • Employee Referral scheme

title: Booking Retention Specialist
description:
Nuovo Artistic Studios is the premier destination for all things self-love. A by-women company and one of the largest artistic photography companies in North America, Nuovo is on a mission to empower individuals by fostering confidence and self-expression while celebrating intimacy and individuality.

We are searching for a Booking Retention Specialist to serve as the vital bridge between our clients and their upcoming studio experiences. Based at our Montreal location, this role is dedicated to protecting our schedule, maximizing studio attendance, and ensuring every client feels supported, excited, and valued from the moment they book.

This pivotal role requires a unique mix of empathetic communication and persuasive drive. You will be the go-to voice for confirming upcoming appointments, re-engaging unconfirmed or hesitant clients, and expertly handling day-of logistics—whether guiding a lost client to our doors, managing schedule adjustments, or reigniting their excitement for their photoshoot.

This is an excellent opportunity for a solution-oriented professional with a strong sales mindset who thrives in a fast-paced, creative setting and takes pride in delivering exceptional client care while driving revenue retention.

What You’ll Do:

  • Proactively manage pre-shoot outreach: Conduct daily outbound call and messaging campaigns to re-engage, confirm, and secure unconfirmed bookings ahead of their scheduled sessions.
  • Overcome hesitations & sell the experience: Actively handle client doubts, address objections, and reignite their excitement to minimize cancellations and eliminate no-shows.
  • Handle day-of studio support: Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming calls, assisting clients with location guidance, last-minute delays, and real-time scheduling adjustments.
  • Drive schedule optimization & rebooking: Efficiently reschedule missed or canceled appointments, turning potential losses into confirmed future studio sessions.
  • Maintain high-touch empathy & enthusiasm: Deliver warm, solution-oriented, and upbeat service to make clients feel confident, valued, and comfortable prior to their arrival.
  • Track retention metrics & KPIs: Monitor success through key indicators, including confirmation rates, no-show reduction, call volume, and rebooking conversions.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with the initial sales team and studio coordinators to ensure seamless communication and a smooth transition into the photoshoot experience.

Requirements

About You:

  • You bring 2–5 years of experience in a role that balances customer care, hospitality, or front-desk reception with phone-based sales, retention, or appointment setting.
  • You have a warm, charismatic, and persuasive phone presence that puts people at ease while confidently steering conversations to secure commitments.
  • You are persuasive and sales-minded, with a demonstrated ability to overcome objections, build rapport quickly over the phone, and re-engage hesitant clients with enthusiasm.
  • You stay calm, ultra-positive, and solution-focused when a client is lost, stuck in traffic, or having a last-minute panic.
  • You take pride in balancing care and conversion, making clients feel truly valued while keeping a sharp eye on numbers like no-show reduction.
  • You are a clear and fluent communicator in English, both written and verbal (speaking French or Spanish is a huge plus!).
  • You are tech-comfortable and quick to pick up new tools, CRMs, scheduling software, Slack, and Google Workspace.
  • You bring high energy, empathy, and adaptability to work every day, thriving in a fast-paced, creative setting where no two days look quite the same.

Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Inspiring Work Environment: Immerse yourself in a creative, collaborative company where artistry and empowerment converge.
  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a fast-growing company committed to nurturing talent and fostering career development.
  • Recognition and Support: A team that values your contributions and celebrates your success.
  • Exclusive Perks: Access to Nuovo’s services and products, ensuring you, too, can experience the power of portraiture. We also provide you with a 50% Family & Friends discount.

About Us:

Nuovo Artistic Studios is not just a photography studio; it’s a movement designed to uplift, empower, and transform. Our mission is to provide every guest with a luxury experience that inspires confidence and celebrates individuality. With studios across North America, we are redefining the art of modern portraiture, one empowered story at a time.

This is your opportunity to join a team dedicated to excellence and artistry. Become part of the Nuovo legacy and make an impact, one unforgettable moment at a time.

This is your moment. Apply today!

title: Network Engineer II
description:
Position Overview

United Health Services (UHS) is seeking an experienced Network Engineer to design, deploy, maintain, and support communication network infrastructure that enables connectivity across UHS and between UHS and external partners. Optimize network performance and capacity through proactive monitoring, performance analysis, troubleshooting, outage resolution, and strategic infrastructure enhancements. Ensure the security and integrity of network systems by establishing and enforcing security standards, managing access controls, conducting security assessments and audits, and implementing recommended security measures to mitigate risk and maintain compliance.

Primary Department, Division, or Unit:

Infrastructure and Server Support, UHS Information Systems Operations

Primary Work Shift:

Day

Regular Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Compensation Range:

$37.00 - $55.50 per hour, depending on experience

-----

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise communication networks across UHS and in collaboration with external partner organizations.

  • Lead the architecture, deployment, and administration of network infrastructure, with a primary focus on Cisco networking technologies, including routing, switching, wireless, and network management solutions.

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize next-generation firewall environments, with a strong preference for experience supporting Palo Alto Networks security platforms.

  • Monitor network performance, capacity, and availability to ensure reliable and secure operations. Troubleshoot complex network issues, resolve outages, implement upgrades, and recommend infrastructure enhancements to improve performance and scalability.

  • Establish, maintain, and enforce network standards, policies, procedures, and best practices by defining system architecture, directing installations, and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

  • Strengthen the organization's cybersecurity posture by managing access controls, participating in security audits and assessments, implementing security recommendations, and supporting network security initiatives.

  • Install, configure, and support core and edge network switches, wireless systems, firewalls, VPN technologies, content filtering solutions, network security tools, VoIP systems, and video conferencing platforms.

  • Develop and maintain network diagrams, technical documentation, standards, operating procedures, and configuration records to support operational excellence and knowledge sharing.

  • Create training materials and provide technical guidance and mentoring to IT staff, including Help Desk, Desktop Support, Server Support, and other technical teams.

  • Serve as the network engineering subject matter expert on organizational projects and strategic initiatives. Develop project plans, coordinate activities, manage timelines, and ensure successful project delivery.

  • Collaborate with IT leadership to evaluate emerging technologies, develop infrastructure roadmaps, and support long-term technology planning.

  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to network team members, promoting best practices and fostering professional development.

  • Demonstrate the ability to function as a team lead and emerging leader, supporting departmental objectives, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, and contributing to succession planning efforts within the IT organization.

​

Position Qualifications

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field

  • 3-5 years of experience within a Networking Environment

  • Cisco CCNA within 6 months of hire

Preferred:

  • Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field

  • 6-10 years of experience in a Networking Environment

  • Extensive experience in Network Engineering supporting large-scale enterprise environments

  • Strong expertise with Cisco networking technologies, including routing, switching, wireless, and network infrastructure design

  • Experience administering and supporting Palo Alto firewalls and network security solutions

  • Working knowledge of VoIP technologies and telecommunications infrastructure preferred

  • Proven project management experience, including planning, coordination, execution, and stakeholder communication.

-----

Why You’ll Love Working at UHS

At United Health Services (UHS), we believe every connection—to patients, to purpose, to each other—makes a difference. That’s why we’re intentional about supporting our team in ways that go beyond the job. Whether through meaningful benefits, personal growth, or fun along the way, we’re here to help you thrive in work and life.

A Culture of Connection – We support each other like family and create space for every voice to be heard. Engagement Councils, peer recognition, and initiatives like Walk in my Shoes for senior leaders are just a few ways we foster belonging and collaboration. Outside of work, we stay connected through team events like trivia, trunk-or-treat, volunteer days, our staff choir, or seasonal celebrations.

Comprehensive Benefits for Life & Family – We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first of the month after hire for employees working 24+ hours/week. With flexible plan options and coverage tiers, you can choose what fits your life best. Additional perks include discounted childcare through Bright Horizons and voluntary benefits like pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection.

​Well-Being & Financial Security – From day one, PTO starts accruing so you can take time to recharge. We support your long-term wellness with a 403(b) retirement plan and company match, flexible spending accounts, access to financial advisors, and up to $400/year in wellness rewards. When life gets tough, we’re here with 24/7 EAP counseling, virtual mental health support, a food pantry, PTO donation program, and professional attire through the Classy Closet.

​Growth That Moves with You – With access to 100,000+ online courses, leadership programs, tuition reimbursement, clinical ladders, and internal mobility, we help you grow wherever your passion leads. We also continuously review compensation to ensure market competitiveness and internal equity, so you can feel confident your work is valued and rewarded fairly.

​A Place to Call Home – Located in New York’s Southern Tier, UHS offers more than a career—we offer a lifestyle. Enjoy four-season recreation, affordable living, top-rated schools, minor league sports, craft brews, a close-knit community, and more, all within reach of the Finger Lakes, the Catskills, and major Northeast cities.

-----

About United Health Services

United Health Services (UHS) is a locally owned, not-for-profit healthcare system in New York’s Southern Tier comprising four hospitals, long-term care and home care services, and physician practices in Broome and surrounding counties. UHS provides healthcare and medical services for two-thirds of the region’s population, produces $1.3 billion a year in total economic impact, and boasts a workforce of more than 6,300 employees and providers.

At UHS, our work is guided by our Values of Compassion, Trust, Respect, Teamwork, and Innovation. Whether you provide direct patient care or support behind the scenes, you are part of a shared purpose: to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve. Every employee plays a meaningful role in fulfilling our mission—we’d love for you to consider joining us!

United Health Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

-----

United Health Services, Inc. and the members of the UHS System neither are affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed nor approved by, nor otherwise associated with, Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS), UHS of Delaware, Inc. nor their affiliates, which can be found at www.uhsinc.com.

title: Assistant Director Japanese School (part-time, every Saturday)

· Incorporates cultural curriculum, including seasonal events, traditions, and project-based learning to strengthen cultural identity and engagement.

· Collaborates with faculty to review curriculum outcomes, share instructional practices, and refine teaching materials.

· Selects and updates learning materials, including leveled readers, kanji practice tools, workbooks, and digital resources appropriate for a heritage-language context.

Requirements

· Three years of teaching experience in elementary or middle school required

· Japanese fluency required

· Japanese elementary or middle school teaching certified

· Leadership experience in guiding and supporting faculty and staff

Benefits

The hourly rate for this position is $45 per hour.

title: Senior QA Specialist
description:
Craft:

Customer & Game Support

Job Description:

Your role within our Kingdom

If you want to create amazing user experiences and entertainment for millions of players to enjoy, then this is the right role for you. As a Senior QA Specialist, you will play a key role in helping Pet Rescue Saga deliver the high-quality experiences that King stands for.

You will be a quality expert within your team, combining hands-on testing expertise with strong ownership, technical guidance, and a focus on continuous improvement. Working closely with agile development teams, you will lead quality activities across complex features and releases, identify and manage risks, support effective decision-making, and help ensure quality is considered throughout the development lifecycle.

You will also contribute beyond individual feature delivery by mentoring others, improving testing practices and ways of working, and helping strengthen quality across the Catalog Games team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead quality execution within the subteam, translating product and quality goals into clear test strategies, risk-based approaches, and release plans.
  • Own quality across complex features and systems from early development through release and live monitoring, ensuring risks, dependencies, and quality criteria are understood and addressed.
  • Lead risk analysis for complex features and feature interactions, continuously improving Risk-Based Testing practices based on release outcomes and learnings.
  • Drive testability from the start by influencing design and implementation discussions, evolving quality criteria and the team's Definition of Done.
  • Use production insights, test evidence, logs, and quality indicators to identify gaps, support root-cause analysis, and drive improvements that reduce future risk.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across different audiences, using evidence and product context to support recommendations and decisions.
  • Navigate ambiguity independently, make informed decisions, challenge assumptions constructively, and balance short-term delivery with longer-term player and product impact.
  • Mentor and coach other QA Specialists, reviewing test approaches and sharing knowledge, risks, edge cases, and best practices.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve team processes, testing practices, collaboration, and QA Craft standards.
  • Contribute positively to team health by giving and receiving feedback, raising issues constructively, and role-modelling expected behaviours.

Skills to create thrills

  • Strong experience in mobile game testing, SDLC and live operations, including release validation and production monitoring.
  • Strong exploratory testing, risk analysis, test design, and defect investigation skills.
  • Experience testing complex systems and integrations, with an understanding of API, integration, component, and end-to-end testing approaches.
  • Working knowledge of test automation, CI/CD pipelines, build processes, crash logs, and quality monitoring.
  • Experience with JIRA, Confluence, TestRail, or equivalent project and test management tools.

title: Principal Investigator (Terrestrial Archaeology - Guam)
description:
Title: Principal Investigator
Location: Guam
Job Code: Guam_PI_2026
Job Link: SEARCH Job Postings - Direct Applications

Position Information

SEARCH has an immediate opening for a Full-Time Principal Investigator to join our Guam office team. Candidates must be based in/relocate to Guam and report to the local office. The responsibilities include fieldwork (e.g., archaeological monitoring and excavation), research, lab, and report preparation tasks. The duties include ensuring fieldwork is executed in a timely fashion and meets the applicable standards; writing high quality technical reports; oversight of junior field staff; and coordinating the development of project Health & Safety plans. The candidate should be detail-oriented and organized, work well with others, and be able to work efficiently on simultaneous projects under tight deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment, and the ability to travel are critical to the position. In particular, this position may require extensive archaeological monitoring on Guam and other locations.

Successful candidates will have a background in cultural resource management and experience managing archaeological fieldwork. The candidate will have excellent technical writing skills and the ability to produce reports for review by subject matter experts on behalf of federal, state, and tribal agencies under Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act and the National Environmental Policy Act, among other historic preservation laws/regulations.

SEARCH provides a flexible work environment, a professional and collaborative atmosphere, and a wide range of projects and opportunities for our staff. SEARCH offers a competitive total compensation package with strong health and wellness and retirement plans. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, group term life insurance, 401(k) plan with match, 11 paid holidays per year, and Unlimited paid time off (PTO). Pay is commensurate with education and experience.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain the highest professional image for our clients, co-workers, media, and general public.
  • Participate in decision-making regarding research priorities of company and provide information on feasibility of prospective projects.
  • Develop business/client relationships for SEARCH.
  • Develop SEARCH procedures and protocol related to field methods, lab analyses, and report preparation.
  • Prepare proposals for review by Sector Leaders and Management.
  • Develop research designs, outline research procedures to be followed, and identify and/or provide training to junior staff to carry out research.
  • Plan and manage fieldwork, data analysis, and reporting efforts in accordance with project Scope of Work, budget, and schedule.
  • Develop thoroughly researched, comprehensive, and defensible resource evaluations according to the National Register of Historic Places eligibility criteria in accordance with 36 CFR §60.4 and associated National Park Service guidance.
  • Support Project Managers in the delivery of projects on time and under budget.
  • In conjunction with the SEARCH Health & Safety Officer, develop a Health & Safety plan for each assigned project and ensure that it is followed.
  • Communicate project resource needs to Project Managers, Sector Leaders, Directors, and Management, as warranted.
  • Conduct primary research using laboratory equipment, computer resources, and institutional libraries.
  • Provide expertise in field of research to SEARCH colleagues.
  • Prepare reports and papers of completed projects for publication in technical journals, presentation to regulatory agencies or at conferences, or use in further research activities, with approval by the Client and SEARCH Management.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications Required:

  • Graduate degree in Anthropology or related field.
  • Based in/relocating to Guam by hire date.
  • Experience with conducting archaeology in Guam, Hawaii, American Samoa, and/or other regional pacific islands.
  • Supervisory experience encompassing time in field, laboratory, and office.
  • Must meet the Secretary of the Interior’s professional qualifications standards for archaeology and be an RPA or be eligible to become an RPA.
  • Eligible for obtaining military base access passes.
  • Expertise in state and federal laws and guidelines governing cultural resources management.
  • Demonstrated ability to support projects in a timely and cost-effective manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cultural resource studies in a timely and cost-effective manner.
  • Demonstrated client management skills.
  • Superior technical writing skillset to produce high quality technical reports and to prepare awardable proposals.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.


Qualifications Preferred:

  • Understanding of the Cultural Resource Management (CRM) industry (firms, clients, contracts, new research, and projects) at the statewide, regionwide, nationwide, and worldwide level.
  • Five+ (5) years of supervisory experience encompassing time in field, laboratory, and office.
  • Strong regional (pacific islands) archaeological experience.


Application Requirements:

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • References
  • Two writing samples


Other Important Need-to-Know Information:

  • This position may require up to 60% field exposure during peak project periods. Field work will include harsh environmental conditions associated with working in the region (e.g. rugged steep terrain, thick jungle vegetation, torrential rainstorms, high temperatures and humidity).
  • This position will require flexible availability outside of standard working hours.
  • Applicants must be eligible to be employed in the United States.
  • SEARCH is strongly committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where a variety of backgrounds, cultures, orientations, ideas, and talents can flourish.
  • SEARCH is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  • SEARCH is an Affirmative Action Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
  • Employment offers are contingent upon satisfactory verification of criminal, education, driving, and/or employment background checks as well as passing results from a pre-employment drug screen.
  • We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. If you believe you require such assistance to complete this form or, if requested, to participate in an interview, please let us know.

Benefits

SEARCH Compensation and Benefits include:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Per Diem (for overnight travel)
  • SEARCH-subsidized Group Health Insurance (including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage)
  • SEARCH-provided Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • SEARCH-provided Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • SEARCH-provided Group Term Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Emergency Travel Assistance
  • Generous 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Holidays (11)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Merit-Based Raises, Bonuses, and Promotions


About SEARCH:

Overland and underwater, SEARCH is an archaeology firm that deploys the full spectrum of cultural heritage services worldwide. SEARCH2O, its maritime program, is at the forefront of historic shipwreck and submerged pre-contact archaeology, paleolandscape reconstruction, and deep-water archaeology. SEARCH’s staff are cultural resources industry leaders, pioneers, and subject matter experts across 45 Market, Regional, and Research Sectors. Since 1993, SEARCH has completed more than 5,000 commercial and government projects in 48 US states, 6 US territories, and 39 countries spanning 7 continents and 4 oceans. By integrating science, technology, and creativity, SEARCH harnesses the power of the past to advance the projects, places, and people it serves.

For more information about SEARCH, please visit and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter.

title: BODY SHOP PREPPER
description:
PURPOSE


The Body Shop Prepper supports the collision repair team by preparing vehicles and components for body repair and refinishing. This position is responsible for completing disassembly, preparation, cleaning, sanding, masking, and other assigned tasks to help Body Technicians and Refinish Technicians maintain an efficient workflow and deliver high-quality repairs. The Prepper is an important part of the repair process and is expected to protect customer vehicles, maintain a clean and organized work environment, and follow all safety and manufacturer repair procedures.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare vehicles for collision repair and refinishing by completing assigned disassembly and preparation work.
  • Remove and reinstall trim, moldings, lights, bumpers, grilles, mirrors, panels, interior components, and other vehicle components as directed.
  • Properly label, organize, and store removed parts and hardware to prevent loss or damage.
  • Prepare surfaces for body and paint repair by cleaning, sanding, scuffing, feathering, and performing other preparation procedures as assigned.
  • Mask and protect areas of the vehicle that are not being repaired or refinished.
  • Assist Body Technicians with repair preparation and other assigned tasks to maintain workflow.
  • Clean and prepare vehicles and components before they move to the paint/refinish process.
  • Assist with the installation and reassembly of replacement parts and components.
  • Inspect completed preparation and reassembly work to ensure it meets quality expectations before moving the vehicle to the next stage of repair.
  • Protect vehicle interiors, glass, trim, paint, and other components from damage throughout the repair process.
  • Move and stage vehicles safely throughout the body shop and designated lot areas.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, work areas, and supplies in a clean, safe, and organized condition.
  • Follow proper procedures for the handling, storage, and disposal of shop materials, chemicals, and waste.
  • Follow all dealership safety policies, OSHA requirements, manufacturer procedures, and body shop processes.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) and maintain safe work practices at all times.
  • Immediately report additional damage, missing parts, equipment concerns, or repair issues to the Body Shop Manager or Foreman.
  • Assist with maintaining an efficient repair flow by completing assigned work accurately and on schedule.
  • Participate in required training and continuously develop collision repair knowledge and technical skills.
  • Maintain a professional attitude and work cooperatively with all members of the collision repair team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

title: Data Analyst (BI Specialist) - Contract
description:
Position Summary

The BI Specialist / Data Analyst is responsible for turning the data produced by Tayco's manufacturing and business systems into reporting that management and senior management can act on. This position designs, builds, and maintains Power BI reports and data models, writes and tunes the SQL beneath them, and maintains the Crystal Reports used for operational and printed reporting. Working alongside two full stack developers - one on the front end used by the shop floor, one on the back end and administrative side - and a project coordinator, this position complements in-house web and software development with the business intelligence layer that sits above it, and provides reporting, communication, and design support to the project as a whole. This position is based at Tayco's Etobicoke facility.

Posting notice: This posting is for 1 existing vacancy for a 12-month contract position.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, datasets, and data
  • models for management and senior management, including scheduled refreshes,
  • gateway configuration, and workspace access.
  • Write, review, and tune the SQL beneath all reporting, including queries, views, and
  • stored procedures against the ERP and in-house application databases.
  • Develop and maintain Crystal Reports for operational and printed reporting and
  • support the users who depend on them.
  • Translate requests from management into defined reporting requirements, the
  • definitions, and the level of detail required - and confirm those definitions before
  • building.
  • Apply consistent visual design to reports and dashboards so that the intended
  • audience can read them immediately, including layout, visual hierarchy, and
  • appropriate selection of charts and tables.
  • Administer and maintain reporting infrastructure on Windows Server, including
  • scheduled jobs, permissions, service accounts, file shares, and report distribution.
  • Contribute light front-end work to the in-house web applications alongside the
  • development team, including HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap changes and the embedding
  • of reports and dashboards into application pages.
  • Prepare presentation and communication materials for management and senior
  • management, including slide decks, one-page summaries, and status reporting on
  • the project.
  • Use Git and GitHub for version control of report definitions, SQL, and related code,
  • following the team's branching and review practices.
  • Verify reported figures against source systems and investigate and resolve
  • discrepancies before they reach a decision-maker.
  • Document data sources, report definitions, measures, and reporting processes, and
  • keep that documentation current.
  • Provide training and support to report to consumers throughout the organization.
  • Use AI-assisted tools with sound judgement, reviewing what is generated, selecting
  • which problems to delegate, and remaining accountable for every query, measure,
  • and figure delivered.

Requirements

  • information systems, statistics, or a related field, or 3-5 years of industry experience
  • in a business intelligence or data analysis role.
  • Must have demonstrated proficiency with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX
  • measures, Power Query, report design, and the management of publishing and
  • scheduled refreshes.
  • Must have strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregation, window functions, views,
  • and query performance tuning against relational databases.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Crystal Reports is required.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration as it relates to reporting:
  • scheduled tasks, permissions, service accounts, file shares, and report distribution.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, sufficient to make small and safe
  • changes to existing web application pages and to embed reports into them.
  • Must be able to use Git and GitHub for version control, including branching, pull
  • requests, and code review.
  • Must be able to use AI-assisted tools effectively and with judgement, including
  • reviewing what is generated, knowing which problems to hand over, and being able
  • to explain any query or measure delivered.
  • Knowledge of Tayco's reporting environment is an asset: Power BI, Crystal Reports,
  • SQL against the ERP and in-house PostgreSQL databases, Django-based internal
  • applications, Windows Server, and Git and GitHub.
  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services or Power BI Report Server, data
  • warehouse or star schema design, advanced Excel data modelling, Python or R for
  • analysis, Azure data services, or manufacturing and ERP data - production,
  • inventory, purchasing, and sales - is considered an asset.
  • Ability to apply sound visual design judgement to reporting, including layout, visual
  • hierarchy, and selection of charts appropriate to the audience.
  • Ability to gather reporting requirements from management, including clarifying
  • definitions and confirming intent before building.
  • Ability to present findings clearly to a non-technical audience, both in writing and
  • verbally.
  • Ability to question a figure that does not look correct, and to trace it back through
  • the reporting to its source.
  • Ability to work effectively within a small cross-functional team of developers and a
  • project coordinator, and to coordinate reporting work with software development in
  • progress
  • Ability to read and interpret written and oral instructions.
  • Must possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • to prioritize workload.

  • applications.

COMPETENCIES

Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Role Overview
The Director, HSS & Enterprise Compliance, is a senior operational leader responsible for building, scaling, and running Stord’s enterprise HSS function across a high-growth, multi-site fulfillment network. This role carries broad ownership across occupational safety, physical security, loss prevention, and enterprise compliance -- driving the programs, teams, and infrastructure that protect Stord’s people, assets, and operations while positioning compliance as a commercial strength that supports customer growth and revenue.
Reporting to the Head of Health, Safety & Security, the Director translates enterprise strategy into an operating organization -- leading Compliance Program Managers, and a network of site-level professionals to deliver consistent, high-quality HSS performance across every facility. This leader is equally comfortable in an executive conversation about risk and regulatory posture as they are reviewing corrective action trends with a Regional Leadership or supporting a customer audit. They bring operational discipline, regulatory depth, and a growth mindset to a function that directly influences Stord’s ability to win and retain business.

Compliance is not a back-office function under this leader -- it is a front-line competitive capability. The Director ensures Stord’s compliance programs are enterprise-grade, credible, and structured to scale with the business, enabling sales to lead with confidence.

What This Role Owns

The Director owns the full HSS operating organization and its outcomes -- not just individual programs, but the people, structure, and accountability systems that make those programs work at scale. This includes:

  • The HSS team: recruiting, developing, and leading Compliance Program Managers, and through them the full network of site-level HSS professionals.

  • Enterprise HSS strategy execution: translating the vision set by the Head of HSS into an operating plan with clear priorities, milestones, metrics, and accountability across the organization.

  • Enterprise compliance program performance: owning the outcomes of Stord’s OSHA, EPA, GMP, DOT, and adjacent compliance programs -- ensuring they are current, enforced, and audit-ready across all facilities.

  • Compliance as a revenue enabler: partnering with Sales and Customer Success to position Stord’s compliance capabilities as a differentiator in the market, supporting regulated customer onboarding, RFP responses, and customer audit readiness.

  • Safety and security program governance: setting performance expectations, reviewing regional and site-level outcomes, and driving continuous improvement across occupational safety, physical security, and loss prevention.

  • Risk management: identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating enterprise-level HSS risks -- physical, regulatory, financial, and reputational -- before they affect operations or customers.

  • HSS budget and resources: managing the function’s operating budget, headcount planning, and technology investments to ensure the organization is properly resourced for current and future scale.

  • Cross-functional leadership: serving as the senior HSS voice in partnerships with Operations, Legal, HR, Finance, CX, and Sales -- ensuring HSS is integrated into business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Organizational Development

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of Regional Managers, Compliance Program Managers, and through them a network of site-level HSS professionals across a multi-site fulfillment network.

  • Set a high-performance culture within the HSS organization: clear expectations, direct feedback, and a development-first approach that builds the bench for future growth.

  • Recruit and hire critical roles within the HSS function, including partnering with HR on sourcing, assessment, and onboarding.

  • Conduct regular operating reviews to assess performance, address trends, and maintain alignment on enterprise priorities.

  • Identify capability gaps across the team and build targeted development plans, training investments, and succession pipelines that keep the organization ahead of Stord’s growth.

  • Represent the HSS function in senior leadership forums, ensuring the team’s work is visible, understood, and connected to broader business objectives.

Compliance Program Leadership

  • Provide senior leadership and strategic direction for Stord’s enterprise compliance programs across OSHA, EPA, GMP, GDP, DOT, Hazmat, and applicable state and local regulatory frameworks.

  • Oversee the Compliance Program Managers in building and sustaining the compliance program architecture -- holding each accountable for program quality, audit readiness, and regulatory currency within their respective domains.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for compliance matters, including regulatory agency interactions, significant inspection findings, customer audit outcomes, and compliance-related legal inquiries.

  • Drive compliance performance across Regional Managers and site teams -- setting expectations, reviewing metrics, and intervening on systemic gaps before they become regulatory or reputational risks.

  • Ensure Stord’s compliance posture scales with the business: as new sites open, new customers onboard, and new regulatory requirements emerge, the compliance program keeps pace.

  • Lead the development and maintenance of Stord’s customer-facing compliance narrative -- supporting RFP responses, customer audits, and sales conversations with a credible, current picture of program maturity.

Occupational Safety Program Oversight

  • Own occupational safety outcomes across the network -- driving improvement in TRIR, DART, near-miss reporting rates, and corrective action quality through Regional Managers and site teams.

  • Review enterprise safety performance data regularly, identify systemic trends, and direct the Compliance Program Managers and Regional Managers to address root causes at the program and operational level.

  • Partner with the Head of HSS and the Compliance Program Managers to ensure safety written programs, policies, and standards remain current, enforced, and aligned with regulatory requirements.

  • Provide executive-level oversight of serious incident investigations -- reviewing findings, approving corrective actions, and ensuring post-incident learnings are applied across the network.

  • Support new site launches, automation deployments, and peak planning by ensuring safety requirements are embedded in operational planning from the start.

Physical Security and Loss Prevention Oversight

  • Own physical security and loss prevention program outcomes across the network -- setting the standards, reviewing performance, and holding Regional Managers and site teams accountable for execution.

  • Provide senior oversight of significant loss prevention investigations, including internal integrity matters, large-scale theft, and fraud -- ensuring investigations are conducted properly and outcomes are handled appropriately with HR and Legal.

  • Partner with Legal and HR on workplace violence prevention programs, active threat response, and sensitive security matters requiring executive involvement.

  • Review loss prevention and shrink metrics across the network and direct on systemic risk mitigation strategies.

  • Ensure physical security standards -- access control, CCTV, perimeter, and visitor management -- are current, enforced, and aligned with customer and industry requirements such as CTPAT and TAPA.

Compliance as a Commercial Capability

  • Partner with Sales, CX, and Account Management to ensure Stord’s compliance capabilities are understood, communicated, and actively used to win and retain business.

  • Lead or support compliance-related customer conversations, including pre-sales qualification, audit preparation, and post-audit corrective action reviews.

  • Develop and maintain a library of compliance credentials, certifications, and program documentation that enables Sales to respond quickly and credibly to customer compliance requirements.

  • Assess compliance requirements for prospective customers and new market segments -- providing clear go/no-go guidance to commercial and operations leadership on regulated customer onboarding.

  • Partner with Customer Success to monitor customer-specific compliance commitments and ensure site teams are meeting them consistently.

Risk Management and Governance

  • Own the enterprise HSS risk register -- identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and tracking mitigation for the highest-impact safety, security, and compliance risks across the network.

  • Lead the Safety and Security Steering Committee in partnership with the Head of HSS -- preparing agendas, presenting performance data, and driving cross-functional decisions on risk and governance.

  • Manage Stord’s insurance relationships from the HSS side -- providing accurate, current performance data to insurers, supporting loss control audits, and identifying opportunities to improve coverage terms through program performance.

  • Serve as a senior leader during major incidents -- providing executive oversight of response, coordinating with Legal and HR, managing external communications, and driving thorough post-incident reviews.

  • Ensure the HSS function maintains audit-ready documentation and governance records that demonstrate program maturity to regulators, customers, and Stord’s board and investors.

Reporting, Metrics, and Business Alignment

  • Own enterprise HSS reporting to the Head of HSS and senior leadership -- delivering regular performance updates that connect safety, compliance, and security outcomes to operational and financial impact.

  • Partner with the Compliance Program Managers to ensure the compliance dashboard and metrics infrastructure gives leadership real-time visibility into risk posture and program health across both program domains.

  • Develop and present HSS business cases to senior leadership -- translating program investments into risk reduction, insurance savings, operational efficiency, and revenue protection.

  • Ensure HSS metrics are integrated into Stord’s broader operational reporting cadences -- visible alongside financial and operational performance, not siloed in a separate function.

  • Drive a continuous improvement mindset across the HSS organization -- using data to identify the highest-value opportunities for program investment and operational risk reduction.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in health, safety, security, or compliance leadership, with at least 3 years in a director-level or equivalent senior leadership role.

  • Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary HSS teams across a multi-site network in 3PL, eCommerce fulfillment, distribution, or a similarly complex logistics environment.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling enterprise compliance programs with measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience operating as a cross-functional senior leader -- influencing Sales, Operations, Legal, HR, and Finance on HSS-related decisions.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep working knowledge of OSHA, EPA, GMP/GDP, DOT, and adjacent regulatory frameworks applicable to warehouse and fulfillment operations.

  • Strong background in enterprise compliance program design, governance, and performance management.

  • Experience with physical security programs, loss prevention strategy, and integrity investigation oversight.

  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements and risk profiles into clear business narratives for executive and commercial audiences.

  • Familiarity with compliance management systems, audit platforms, and HSS performance reporting infrastructure.

Credentials (Preferred)

  • CSP (Certified Safety Professional) or equivalent senior safety credential preferred.

  • CHMM (Certified Hazardous Materials Manager) or equivalent environmental/Hazmat credential a plus.

  • LPC, LPQ, or equivalent loss prevention credential preferred.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or operational excellence background a plus.

  • Experience supporting CTPAT, TAPA, GMP, or SOC-related certification programs preferred.

Leadership Profile

  • A senior leader who earns credibility through expertise, follow-through, and results.

  • Equally effective in a regulatory agency interaction, a customer compliance review, and a coaching conversation with a Regional Manager.

  • Commercially minded: understands how compliance and safety performance connect to revenue, margin, and customer retention.

  • Decisive under pressure -- able to lead the organization through significant incidents, regulatory challenges, and peak operational stress without losing focus.

  • A developer of people -- invests in the growth of the team and builds an organization that performs without requiring their personal involvement in every decision.

  • A clear, confident communicator at all levels -- from a frontline employee concern to a board-level risk briefing.

title: Youth Development Professional
description:
Boys & Girls Clubs of Carson’s Mission:

The Boys & Girls Clubs of Carson offers our young people a safe environment where they can have fun and be themselves around dedicated adult mentors who respect and listen to them. Outcome-based programs empower youth to become lifelong learners.


PRIMARY FUNCTION:

Plans, implements, supervises and evaluates activities provided within a specific program area, such as Education, Special Education, Social Recreation, Arts & Crafts and Physical Education. The primary focus will be to provide programming.


KEY ROLES (Essential Job Responsibilities):

Prepare Youth for Success

• Promote and stimulate program participation.

• Register new members and participate in their Club orientation process.

• Provide guidance and role modeling to members.

Program Development and Implementation

• Effectively implement and administer programs, services and activities for drop-in members and visitors.

• Provide daily homework and tutoring assistance for members.

• Maintain and keep files of attendance.

• Collect all required documentation to operate programs.

• Collect and maintain members’ report cards as they are distributed from schools.

• Take inventory and order supplies as needed.

• Address concerns, questions, issues of parents and or teachers.

Supervision

• rules of the club and all the recreational areas.

title: Baker (Artisan Bread Specialist)
description:

PAUL, the internationally renowned French bakery, pastry and café brand operating in more than 50 countries, is looking for skilled Bakers (Artisan Bread Specialists) to join our central production bakery in Glyfada, Athens.

At PAUL, we combine traditional French baking techniques with modern production standards to create high-quality artisan breads and bakery products every day.

We are looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft, enjoy working as part of a team and are committed to delivering exceptional quality.

Requirements

  • Monitor the quality of raw materials and finished products.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to maintain an efficient production environment.

title: Broista – Ozark, MO
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering next-level service.   • Adaptable and quick; you can handle a rush and keep the kindness rolling.
  • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.

  • Committed to growth and always looking for ways to improve.

  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values: radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.

Up to $22.00 per hour
